  n_rows: 1000000
  widths: [11, 101, 1001]
  times: 20
  times_custom: 5

  probe_limit: 60

  ext_rows: 10000000
  ext_times: 10

  skip_ext: false
  rebuild: false

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Library path first, then cuplyr from the checkout named by params$root: an
# older cuplyr is installed in the user library and must never be the one
# that runs. Nothing is installed.
.libPaths(c(params$lib, .libPaths()))
# the start of this render, for "This render took" at the end of the document
render_t0 <- Sys.time()
pkgload::load_all(params$root, quiet = TRUE, debug = FALSE)
source("rolling-lib.R")

n_rows <- as.numeric(params$n_rows)
widths <- sort(as.numeric(unlist(params$widths)))
stopifnot(length(widths) == 3L)
w_lo <- widths[1]; w_mid <- widths[2]; w_hi <- widths[3]
times <- as.numeric(params$times); times_c <- as.numeric(params$times_custom)
cell_budget <- as.numeric(params$cell_budget); probe_limit <- as.numeric(params$probe_limit)
group_rows <- as.numeric(params$group_rows); n_groups <- as.numeric(params$n_groups)
group_width <- as.numeric(params$group_width)
ext_rows <- as.numeric(params$ext_rows); ext_times <- as.numeric(params$ext_times)
stats_run <- as.character(unlist(params$stats))
if (isTRUE(as.logical(params$skip_ext))) {
  stop("skip_ext = true is not supported: the conclusions compare the extension runs")
}
dir.create(params$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# The knitr cache of the timing chunks is keyed on the chunk code (knitr) and,
# through cache.extra, on the content of rolling-lib.R and of cuplyr's R and
# C++ sources, the versions of everything the benchmark uses, and the run
# parameters (not the directories, which only say where things live).
bench_pkgs <- c("cuplyr", "data.table", "roll", "RollingWindow", "runstats", "slider",
                "RcppRoll", "zoo", "runner", "microbenchmark", "ggdist", "paletteer",
                "ggtext", "ggplot2", "scales", "patchwork", "dplyr", "RcppParallel",
                "fftwtools", "tibble", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "polars", "duckdb", "DBI", "callr")
ver <- c(R = paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."), rw_versions(bench_pkgs))
# polars' Rust crate is a second version to key on (the R package downloads a
# prebuilt library). It is read in a child process, not here: loading polars in
# this process would start its thread pool next to the CUDA context. DuckDB's
# library is bundled in the duckdb package, so the package version is the
# library's version.
polars_crate <- tryCatch(rw_polars_child(NULL, function() polars::polars_info()$versions$rust_crate),
                         error = function(e) "unknown")
# libcudf is the code the cuplyr timings measure, so it is part of the key too
conda_prefix <- Sys.getenv("CONDA_PREFIX")
cudf_json <- if (nzchar(conda_prefix)) list.files(file.path(conda_prefix, "conda-meta"), pattern = "^libcudf-[0-9]", full.names = FALSE) else character()
cudf_ver <- if (length(cudf_json)) sub("^libcudf-([0-9.]+)-.*$", "\\1", cudf_json[1]) else NA_character_
cudf_ver_short <- sub("^([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+).*$", "\\1", cudf_ver)
key_ver <- c(ver, libcudf = if (is.na(cudf_ver)) "unknown" else cudf_ver, polars_rust_crate = polars_crate)
# `rebuild` only forces a rerun (params$rebuild, which FULL_RERUN in
# bench/rolling-window.R passes); it is deliberately not part of the key
key_config <- params[setdiff(names(params), c("root", "out_dir", "cache_dir", "rebuild"))]
# src/Makevars holds the compile flags of cuplyr's C++ (written by configure)
key_files <- c("rolling-lib.R", rw_cuplyr_sources(params$root), file.path(params$root, "src", "Makevars"))
# the key is kept: the render-time record at the end names the code it timed
cache_key <- rw_cache_key(key_files, key_ver, key_config)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  cache.path = file.path(params$cache_dir, ""),
  cache.extra = cache_key,
  cache.rebuild = isTRUE(as.logical(params$rebuild))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: bench-main
#| cache: true
#| include: false
# The main experiment: every statistic x width x function, with the
# single-thread controls, the correctness check against data.table and the
# cuplyr entries. Uploads its own table and returns plain data frames only: a
# cached GPU object would come back as a dead pointer.
bench_main <- local({
  t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  t_clock <- Sys.time()
  has_pkg <- function(p) requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)
  for (p in c("data.table", "microbenchmark")) if (!has_pkg(p)) stop("required package missing: ", p)
  if (!cuplyr::has_gpu()) stop("no GPU")
  n_rows <- as.numeric(params$n_rows)
  widths <- sort(as.numeric(unlist(params$widths)))
  stats_run <- as.character(unlist(params$stats))

  # thread settings as found, before any control changes them
  thread_info <- data.frame(
    item = c("OMP_NUM_THREADS (env)", "data.table getDTthreads()", "RcppRoll roll_threads()",
             "RcppParallel defaultNumThreads()"),
    version = c(if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS"))) Sys.getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS") else "unset",
                data.table::getDTthreads(),
                if (has_pkg("RcppRoll")) RcppRoll::roll_threads() else NA,
                if (has_pkg("RcppParallel")) RcppParallel::defaultNumThreads() else NA),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  df <- rw_data(n_rows)
  x <- df$x
  gt <- cuplyr::tbl_gpu(df)
  fns <- rw_functions()
  timing_rows <- list()
  corr_rows <- list()
  skip_rows <- list()
  add_skip <- function(stat, fn, width, reason) {
    skip_rows[[length(skip_rows) + 1]] <<- rw_skip_row("bench-main", stat, fn, width, reason)
  }
  add_cell <- function(stat, fn, width, res) {
    timing_rows[[length(timing_rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
      stat = stat, fn = fn, width = width, n_rows = n_rows, sample = seq_along(res$ms),
      ms = res$ms, times = res$times, note = res$note, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (!is.null(res$cmp)) {
      corr_rows[[length(corr_rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
        stat = stat, fn = fn, width = width, ok = res$cmp$ok,
        n_na_mismatch = res$cmp$n_na_mismatch, max_abs_diff = res$cmp$max_abs_diff,
        fell_back = res$fell_back %||% NA, note = res$note %||% "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }
  one_cell <- function(call, extract, times, ref) {
    run_cell(call, extract, times, ref, FALSE,
             cell_budget = params$cell_budget, probe_limit = params$probe_limit)
  }

  for (stat in stats_run) {
    rw_say("== statistic: ", stat)
    stat_fns <- fns[[stat]]
    for (width in widths) {
      rw_say("  width ", width)
      ref <- rw_reference(stat, x, width)
      times <- if (stat == "custom") params$times_custom else params$times

      for (fn_name in names(stat_fns)) {
        f <- stat_fns[[fn_name]]
        rw_say("    ", fn_name)
        cell <- function() one_cell(function() f(x, width), identity, times, ref)
        add_cell(stat, fn_name, width, safe_cell(cell))
        # Single-thread control for every entry whose package can use threads.
        pkg <- rw_threaded_pkg(fn_name)
        if (!is.na(pkg) && has_pkg(pkg)) {
          label1 <- rw_one_thread_label(fn_name)
          rw_say("    ", label1)
          add_cell(stat, label1, width, safe_cell(function() with_one_thread(pkg, cell)))
        }
      }

      if (stat != "custom") {
        variants <- list(list(label = "cuplyr", alias = FALSE))
        if (stat != "median") variants[[2]] <- list(label = "cuplyr (froll alias)", alias = TRUE)
        for (v in variants) {
          cf <- rw_cuplyr_fun(stat, alias = v$alias)
          # No cuplyr cell that runs on the CPU fallback is timed: one untimed
          # probe call under cuplyr.fallback = "error" decides first. A probe
          # that fails for another reason is a failed cell, not a skip.
          pr <- rw_native_probe(function() cf(gt, width))
          if (pr$fallback) {
            rw_say("    ", v$label, ": not timed (CPU fallback)")
            add_skip(stat, v$label, width, pr$reason)
            next
          }
          rw_say("    ", v$label, if (!pr$native) ": probe call failed")
          res <- if (pr$native) safe_cell(function() one_cell(function() cf(gt, width), cuplyr_extract, times, ref)) else
            rw_probe_error_cell(pr)
          add_cell(stat, v$label, width, res)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  rm(gt, df, x)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
  list(timings = do.call(rbind, timing_rows), correctness = do.call(rbind, corr_rows),
       skipped = rw_skip_table(skip_rows),
       thread_info = thread_info, secs = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start, started = t_clock)
})
invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
```

```{r}
#| label: bench-overhead
#| cache: true
#| include: false
# Per-call cost: the same cuplyr calls on a small table, where kernel time is
# negligible, so they are the fixed cost of one eager mutate() + compute() +
# fence. A plain arithmetic mutate and a cumsum window mutate are timed next
# to the rolling ones to separate the window chain's extra cost from the bare
# mutate cost. Same harness as everything else (gc-separated, fenced). The
# lazy query plans are captured as text to name the nodes each call builds.
bench_overhead <- local({
  t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  t_clock <- Sys.time()
  n_rows <- as.numeric(params$n_rows)
  w <- sort(as.numeric(unlist(params$widths)))[2]
  stats_run <- as.character(unlist(params$stats))
  small_rows <- 1e3
  small_times <- 50
  rows <- list()
  add_rows <- function(stat, fn, width, n, ms, note) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
      stat = stat, fn = fn, width = width, n_rows = n, sample = seq_along(ms),
      ms = ms, times = length(ms), note = note, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  skip_rows <- list()
  add_skip <- function(stat, fn, width, reason) {
    skip_rows[[length(skip_rows) + 1]] <<- rw_skip_row("bench-overhead", stat, fn, width, reason)
  }
  # a probe call that fails for another reason than a CPU fallback stops the
  # render: these timings have no correctness check to record the failure in
  probe_or_stop <- function(pr, what) {
    if (!pr$native && !pr$fallback) stop("bench-overhead: the probe call of ", what, " failed: ", pr$reason, call. = FALSE)
    pr
  }

  gt_small <- cuplyr::tbl_gpu(rw_data(small_rows))
  for (stat in intersect(stats_run, c("mean", "sum", "min", "max", "sd"))) {
    rw_say("== overhead floor: ", stat)
    cf <- rw_cuplyr_fun(stat)
    # every cuplyr cell is probed for a CPU fallback before it is timed
    pr <- probe_or_stop(rw_native_probe(function() cf(gt_small, w)), paste("the", stat, "overhead floor"))
    if (!pr$native) { add_skip(stat, "cuplyr (1e3-row overhead floor)", w, pr$reason); next }
    ms <- rw_time(function() cf(gt_small, w), small_times, warmup = 5)
    add_rows(stat, "cuplyr (1e3-row overhead floor)", w, small_rows, ms,
             "same call on 1e3 rows; kernel time negligible")
  }

  gt <- cuplyr::tbl_gpu(rw_data(n_rows))
  calls <- rw_overhead_calls(w)
  inputs <- list(list(g = gt_small, n = small_rows, times = small_times),
                 list(g = gt, n = n_rows, times = params$times))
  for (inp in inputs) {
    for (nm in names(calls)) {
      rw_say("== overhead: ", nm, " on ", inp$n, " rows")
      of <- rw_overhead_fn(calls[[nm]])
      pr <- probe_or_stop(rw_native_probe(function() of(inp$g)), paste0(nm, " on ", inp$n, " rows"))
      if (!pr$native) { add_skip("overhead", nm, NA, pr$reason); next }
      ms <- rw_time(function() of(inp$g), inp$times, warmup = 5)
      add_rows("overhead", nm, NA, inp$n, ms, "")
    }
  }

  lz <- cuplyr::as_lazy(gt_small)
  plans <- lapply(calls, function(f) utils::capture.output(dplyr::show_query(f(lz))))
  rm(lz, gt_small, gt, inp, of)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
  list(timings = do.call(rbind, rows), plans = plans, small_rows = small_rows,
       skipped = rw_skip_table(skip_rows), secs = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start, started = t_clock)
})
invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
```

```{r}
#| label: bench-ext
#| cache: true
#| include: false
# Extension: (a) a grouped rolling mean, (b) a larger ungrouped table. Peak
# and held GPU bytes come from one untimed call per cuplyr entry.
bench_ext <- local({
  t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  t_clock <- Sys.time()
  widths <- sort(as.numeric(unlist(params$widths)))
  has_pkg <- function(p) requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)
  ext_list <- list()
  add_ext <- function(experiment, fn, width, n, res, mem = NULL, ok = NA) {
    # a failed cell (safe_cell's error row) has no samples: NA figures
    ms <- res$ms[!is.na(res$ms)]
    q <- function(f) if (length(ms)) unname(f(ms)) else NA_real_
    ext_list[[length(ext_list) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
      experiment = experiment, fn = fn, width = width, n_rows = n,
      median_ms = q(stats::median), q25_ms = q(function(v) stats::quantile(v, .25)),
      q75_ms = q(function(v) stats::quantile(v, .75)), min_ms = q(min), max_ms = q(max),
      times = res$times, peak_gpu_bytes = mem$peak %||% NA_real_,
      held_gpu_bytes_after_call = mem$held %||% NA_real_, correct = ok, note = res$note,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  one_cell <- function(call, extract, ref) {
    run_cell(call, extract, params$ext_times, ref, FALSE,
             cell_budget = params$cell_budget, probe_limit = params$probe_limit)
  }
  skip_rows <- list()
  add_skip <- function(experiment, fn, width, reason) {
    skip_rows[[length(skip_rows) + 1]] <<- rw_skip_row("bench-ext", experiment, fn, width, reason)
  }

  # (a) grouped rolling mean; data.table's own result is the reference
  rw_say("== extension (a): grouped")
  dfg <- rw_grouped_data(params$group_rows, params$n_groups)
  setup <- rw_grouped_setup(dfg, params$group_width)
  g_ref <- setup$data.table$extract(setup$data.table$run())
  grouped_label <- function(nm) switch(nm, slider = "slider (grouped_df)", data.table = "data.table (by = g)", nm)
  for (nm in names(setup)) {
    rw_say("    ", nm)
    e <- setup[[nm]]
    pr <- list(native = TRUE, fallback = FALSE)
    if (nm == "cuplyr") {
      # probed for a CPU fallback before it is timed, like every cuplyr cell;
      # a probe that fails for another reason is a failed cell, not a skip
      pr <- rw_native_probe(e$run)
      if (pr$fallback) { add_skip("grouped mean", "cuplyr", params$group_width, pr$reason); next }
    }
    res <- if (pr$native) safe_cell(function() one_cell(e$run, e$extract, g_ref)) else rw_probe_error_cell(pr)
    mem <- if (nm == "cuplyr" && pr$native) rw_mem_of(e$run) else NULL
    add_ext("grouped mean", grouped_label(nm), params$group_width, params$group_rows, res, mem, res$cmp$ok)
    if (nm == "data.table") {
      rw_say("    data.table (1 thread)")
      res <- safe_cell(function() with_one_thread("data.table", function() one_cell(e$run, e$extract, g_ref)))
      add_ext("grouped mean", "data.table (by = g, 1 thread)", params$group_width, params$group_rows, res, NULL, res$cmp$ok)
    }
  }
  rm(setup, dfg, g_ref, e)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)

  # (b) the larger ungrouped table
  rw_say("== extension (b): ungrouped")
  dfb <- rw_data(params$ext_rows)
  xb <- dfb$x
  gtb <- cuplyr::tbl_gpu(dfb)
  engines <- list(
    cuplyr = NULL,
    data.table = function(x, n) data.table::frollmean(x, n, align = "right"),
    roll = if (has_pkg("roll")) function(x, n) roll::roll_mean(x, n),
    RcppRoll = if (has_pkg("RcppRoll")) function(x, n) RcppRoll::roll_meanr(x, n, fill = NA)
  )
  for (width in widths) {
    refb <- data.table::frollmean(xb, width, align = "right")
    for (nm in names(engines)) {
      rw_say("    ", nm, " width ", width)
      pr <- list(native = TRUE, fallback = FALSE)
      if (nm == "cuplyr") {
        cf <- rw_cuplyr_fun("mean")
        call <- function() cf(gtb, width)
        extract <- cuplyr_extract
        pr <- rw_native_probe(call)
        if (pr$fallback) { add_skip("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", width, pr$reason); next }
      } else {
        f <- engines[[nm]]
        if (is.null(f)) next
        call <- function() f(xb, width)
        extract <- identity
      }
      cell <- function() one_cell(call, extract, refb)
      res <- if (pr$native) safe_cell(cell) else rw_probe_error_cell(pr)
      mem <- if (nm == "cuplyr" && pr$native) rw_mem_of(call) else NULL
      add_ext("ungrouped mean", nm, width, params$ext_rows, res, mem, res$cmp$ok %||% NA)
      if (nm != "cuplyr") {
        rw_say("    ", rw_one_thread_label(nm), " width ", width)
        res <- safe_cell(function() with_one_thread(rw_threaded_pkg(nm), cell))
        add_ext("ungrouped mean", rw_one_thread_label(nm), width, params$ext_rows, res, NULL, res$cmp$ok %||% NA)
      }
    }
    rm(refb)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }
  rm(gtb, dfb, xb)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
  list(ext = do.call(rbind, ext_list), skipped = rw_skip_table(skip_rows),
       secs = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start, started = t_clock)
})
invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
```

```{r}
#| label: bench-engines
#| cache: true
#| include: false
# polars and DuckDB (F73): the same statistics, widths and extensions as
# bench-main and bench-ext, each at the engine's default thread count and at one
# thread. An engine gets its data once, outside timing; the timed call is only
# the rolling computation, to a result that stays inside the engine (a polars
# DataFrame, a DuckDB temp table), the same rule as cuplyr's result on the GPU.
# DuckDB runs in this process, with one connection per (thread setting, dataset),
# each loading its dataset once outside timing and closed with shutdown = TRUE.
# polars runs in a fresh process per setting
# (rw_polars_child()), because its thread pool is fixed when it loads; the child
# sources the same rolling-lib.R as this document (the copy next to the qmd), is
# never given cuplyr (no CUDA context) and returns plain data frames. Nothing
# from the GPU lives in this chunk.
bench_engines <- local({
  t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  t_clock <- Sys.time()
  # polars is only checked for, never loaded here (its thread pool belongs to the
  # child processes); the others are used in this process
  if (!nzchar(system.file(package = "polars"))) stop("required package missing: polars")
  for (p in c("duckdb", "DBI", "callr", "data.table", "microbenchmark")) {
    if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) stop("required package missing: ", p)
  }
  cfg <- list(n_rows = as.numeric(params$n_rows), widths = sort(as.numeric(unlist(params$widths))),
              stats = setdiff(as.character(unlist(params$stats)), "custom"),
              times = as.numeric(params$times), cell_budget = as.numeric(params$cell_budget),
              probe_limit = as.numeric(params$probe_limit), group_rows = as.numeric(params$group_rows),
              n_groups = as.numeric(params$n_groups), group_width = as.numeric(params$group_width),
              ext_rows = as.numeric(params$ext_rows), ext_times = as.numeric(params$ext_times),
              # the per-call floor: the same call on a small table, where the
              # computation is negligible (the same table size, width, statistics
              # and sample count as bench-overhead's floor of cuplyr)
              small_rows = 1e3, floor_times = 50)
  cfg$floor_stats <- intersect(c("mean", "sum", "min", "max", "sd"), cfg$stats)

  # All the cells of one engine configuration: the main grid, the grouped mean,
  # the ungrouped mean at the larger size and the per-call floor on a small
  # table. `make_engine(df)` builds the engine on a data frame (and loads it,
  # untimed); every cell goes through the
  # same run_cell() as the other entries, with the engine's reset (the untimed
  # drop of the previous result) and the check against data.table, NA padding
  # included. It has no free variables of its own: it runs in this process
  # (DuckDB) and in the polars child, where rolling-lib.R was just sourced.
  engine_grid <- function(make_engine, label, cfg) {
    timing_rows <- list(); corr_rows <- list(); ext_list <- list()
    seen_threads <- integer()
    add_cell <- function(stat, width, res) {
      timing_rows[[length(timing_rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
        stat = stat, fn = label, width = width, n_rows = cfg$n_rows, sample = seq_along(res$ms),
        ms = res$ms, times = res$times, note = res$note, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      corr_rows[[length(corr_rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
        stat = stat, fn = label, width = width, ok = res$cmp$ok,
        n_na_mismatch = res$cmp$n_na_mismatch, max_abs_diff = res$cmp$max_abs_diff,
        fell_back = res$fell_back %||% NA, note = res$note %||% "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
    add_ext <- function(experiment, width, n, res) {
      ms <- res$ms[!is.na(res$ms)]
      q <- function(f) if (length(ms)) unname(f(ms)) else NA_real_
      ext_list[[length(ext_list) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
        experiment = experiment, fn = label, width = width, n_rows = n,
        median_ms = q(stats::median), q25_ms = q(function(v) stats::quantile(v, .25)),
        q75_ms = q(function(v) stats::quantile(v, .75)), min_ms = q(min), max_ms = q(max),
        times = res$times, peak_gpu_bytes = NA_real_, held_gpu_bytes_after_call = NA_real_,
        correct = res$cmp$ok, note = res$note, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
    with_engine <- function(df, body) {
      eng <- make_engine(df)
      on.exit(eng$close(), add = TRUE)
      seen_threads <<- c(seen_threads, eng$threads())
      body(eng)
    }
    cell <- function(eng, stat, grouped, width, times, ref) {
      f <- eng$fun(stat, grouped)
      res <- safe_cell(function() {
        run_cell(function() f(width), eng$extract, times, ref, FALSE,
                 cell_budget = cfg$cell_budget, probe_limit = cfg$probe_limit, reset = eng$reset)
      })
      eng$reset()
      res
    }

    df <- rw_data(cfg$n_rows)
    with_engine(df, function(eng) {
      for (stat in cfg$stats) for (width in cfg$widths) {
        rw_say("    ", label, " ", stat, " width ", width)
        add_cell(stat, width, cell(eng, stat, FALSE, width, cfg$times, rw_reference(stat, df$x, width)))
      }
    })

    # (a) grouped: data.table per group, in the original row order, is the reference
    dfg <- rw_grouped_data(cfg$group_rows, cfg$n_groups)
    g_ref <- numeric(nrow(dfg))
    for (k in split(seq_len(nrow(dfg)), dfg$g)) {
      g_ref[k] <- data.table::frollmean(dfg$x[k], cfg$group_width, align = "right")
    }
    with_engine(dfg, function(eng) {
      rw_say("    ", label, " grouped mean")
      add_ext("grouped mean", cfg$group_width, cfg$group_rows,
              cell(eng, "mean", TRUE, cfg$group_width, cfg$ext_times, g_ref))
    })
    rm(dfg, g_ref)

    # (b) the larger ungrouped table
    dfb <- rw_data(cfg$ext_rows)
    with_engine(dfb, function(eng) {
      for (width in cfg$widths) {
        rw_say("    ", label, " ", cfg$ext_rows, " rows width ", width)
        add_ext("ungrouped mean", width, cfg$ext_rows,
                cell(eng, "mean", FALSE, width, cfg$ext_times, data.table::frollmean(dfb$x, width, align = "right")))
      }
    })
    rm(dfb, df)

    # (c) the per-call floor: the same call on a small table, at the middle width.
    # A floor measured on a wrong result is no floor, so a mismatch stops the chunk.
    w_floor <- cfg$widths[2]
    dfs <- rw_data(cfg$small_rows)
    floor_rows <- list()
    with_engine(dfs, function(eng) {
      for (stat in cfg$floor_stats) {
        rw_say("    ", label, " ", cfg$small_rows, " rows (floor) ", stat)
        res <- cell(eng, stat, FALSE, w_floor, cfg$floor_times, rw_reference(stat, dfs$x, w_floor))
        if (!isTRUE(res$cmp$ok)) stop(label, ": the ", cfg$small_rows, "-row floor call for ", stat, " did not match data.table")
        floor_rows[[length(floor_rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
          stat = stat, fn = paste0(label, " (1e3-row overhead floor)"), width = w_floor, n_rows = cfg$small_rows,
          sample = seq_along(res$ms), ms = res$ms, times = res$times, note = "same call on 1e3 rows; computation negligible",
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }
    })
    rm(dfs)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
    if (length(unique(seen_threads)) != 1L) stop(label, ": the engine reported different thread counts within one grid")
    list(timings = do.call(rbind, timing_rows), correctness = do.call(rbind, corr_rows),
         ext = do.call(rbind, ext_list), floor = do.call(rbind, floor_rows), threads = seen_threads[[1]])
  }
  environment(engine_grid) <- globalenv()

  # What the polars child runs. rolling-lib.R is sourced by absolute path (the
  # copy this document sourced); cuplyr is never loaded.
  child_job <- function(lib_file, grid, label, cfg) {
    source(lib_file)
    environment(grid) <- globalenv()
    out <- grid(rw_polars_engine, label, cfg)
    info <- polars::polars_info()
    out$polars <- list(rust_crate = info$versions$rust_crate, nightly = isTRUE(info$features$nightly))
    out
  }
  environment(child_job) <- globalenv()
  lib_file <- normalizePath("rolling-lib.R", mustWork = TRUE)

  settings <- list(list(config = "default", threads = NULL, suffix = ""),
                   list(config = "1 thread", threads = 1L, suffix = " (1 thread)"))
  parts <- list(); thread_rows <- list(); polars_info <- NULL
  add_part <- function(engine, config, out) {
    parts[[length(parts) + 1]] <<- out[c("timings", "correctness", "ext", "floor")]
    thread_rows[[length(thread_rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(engine = engine, config = config,
                                                         threads = out$threads, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  tmp <- rw_duckdb_engine(data.frame(x = 1))
  duckdb_lib <- tmp$version()
  tmp$close()
  for (s in settings) {
    rw_say("== DuckDB, ", s$config)
    add_part("DuckDB", s$config, engine_grid(function(df) rw_duckdb_engine(df, s$threads),
                                             paste0("DuckDB", s$suffix), cfg))
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }
  for (s in settings) {
    rw_say("== polars, ", s$config, " (child process)")
    out <- rw_polars_child(s$threads, child_job,
                           list(lib_file = lib_file, grid = engine_grid, label = paste0("polars", s$suffix), cfg = cfg),
                           show = TRUE)
    add_part("polars", s$config, out)
    polars_info <- out$polars
  }
  list(timings = do.call(rbind, lapply(parts, `[[`, "timings")),
       correctness = do.call(rbind, lapply(parts, `[[`, "correctness")),
       ext = do.call(rbind, lapply(parts, `[[`, "ext")),
       floor = do.call(rbind, lapply(parts, `[[`, "floor")), small_rows = cfg$small_rows,
       threads = do.call(rbind, thread_rows), skipped = rw_skip_table(list()),
       duckdb_lib = duckdb_lib, polars = polars_info, secs = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start, started = t_clock)
})
invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
```

```{r}
#| label: bench-memory
#| cache: true
#| include: false
# Memory: bytes allocated and held right after one call (the result is still
# referenced, so held = result + whatever intermediates have not been
# finalized yet), the peak, and the bytes held after a gc() (the result
# alone), for a rolling mean, a plain arithmetic mutate and a cumsum window
# mutate. Then back-to-back rolling calls without gc(): the finding reported
# as F1.
bench_memory <- local({
  t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  t_clock <- Sys.time()
  w <- sort(as.numeric(unlist(params$widths)))[2]
  n_ext <- as.numeric(params$ext_rows)
  dfm <- rw_data(n_ext)
  gtm <- cuplyr::tbl_gpu(dfm)
  cf <- rw_cuplyr_fun("mean")
  calls <- rw_overhead_calls(w)
  mem_calls <- stats::setNames(list(
    function() cf(gtm, w),
    function() rw_overhead_fn(calls[[1]])(gtm),
    function() rw_overhead_fn(calls[[3]])(gtm)
  ), c(names(calls)[2], names(calls)[1], names(calls)[3]))
  # every cuplyr call is probed for a CPU fallback before it is measured; a
  # probe that fails for another reason stops the render (there is no
  # correctness check here to record it in)
  skip_rows <- list()
  native <- vapply(names(mem_calls), function(nm) {
    pr <- rw_native_probe(mem_calls[[nm]])
    if (!pr$native && !pr$fallback) stop("bench-memory: the probe call of ", nm, " failed: ", pr$reason, call. = FALSE)
    if (!pr$native) skip_rows[[length(skip_rows) + 1]] <<- rw_skip_row("bench-memory", "memory", nm, NA, pr$reason)
    pr$native
  }, TRUE)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
  breakdown <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(mem_calls)[native], function(nm) {
    rw_say("== memory: ", nm)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
    one <- cuplyr:::gpu_alloc_tracking(mem_calls[[nm]]())
    row <- data.frame(call = nm, n_rows = n_ext, x_column_bytes = 8 * n_ext,
                      allocated_bytes = one$allocated_bytes, held_after_call_bytes = one$held_bytes,
                      peak_bytes = one$peak_bytes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    rm(one)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
    after_gc <- cuplyr:::gpu_alloc_tracking({ r <- mem_calls[[nm]](); gc(verbose = FALSE); r })
    row$held_after_gc_bytes <- after_gc$held_bytes
    rm(after_gc)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
    row
  }))

  # back-to-back calls without gc(); each result is dropped, only unfinalized
  # intermediates linger
  n_calls <- 20
  oom_at <- NA_integer_
  err <- ""
  if (native[[1]]) {
    rw_say("== memory: ", n_calls, " back-to-back calls without gc()")
    for (i in seq_len(n_calls)) {
      r <- tryCatch(cf(gtm, w), error = function(e) { err <<- conditionMessage(e); NULL })
      if (is.null(r)) { oom_at <- i; break }
      rm(r)
    }
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }
  first <- function(col) if (native[[1]]) breakdown[[col]][1] else NA_real_
  finding <- data.frame(
    n_rows = n_ext, held_after_one_call_bytes = first("held_after_call_bytes"),
    peak_one_call_bytes = first("peak_bytes"), result_table_bytes = first("held_after_gc_bytes"),
    n_calls = n_calls, failed_at_call = oom_at, error = substr(err, 1, 200))
  rm(gtm, dfm)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
  list(breakdown = breakdown, finding = finding, skipped = rw_skip_table(skip_rows),
       secs = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start, started = t_clock)
})
invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
```

```{r}
#| label: bench-fence
#| cache: true
#| include: false
# What the gpu_sync() fence costs: the same rolling-mean call on
# the larger table, with and without it, through the same gc-separated
# harness. The two variants are timed in alternation (rw_time_interleaved), so
# a drift of the machine's state hits both alike.
bench_fence <- local({
  t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  t_clock <- Sys.time()
  w <- sort(as.numeric(unlist(params$widths)))[2]
  dfb <- rw_data(as.numeric(params$ext_rows))
  gtb <- cuplyr::tbl_gpu(dfb)
  with_fence <- rw_cuplyr_fun("mean", fence = TRUE)
  without_fence <- rw_cuplyr_fun("mean", fence = FALSE)
  rw_say("== fence on / off")
  pr <- rw_native_probe(function() with_fence(gtb, w))
  # a probe that fails for another reason than a CPU fallback stops the render
  if (!pr$native && !pr$fallback) stop("bench-fence: the probe call failed: ", pr$reason, call. = FALSE)
  if (pr$native) {
    timings <- rw_time_interleaved(list(on = function() with_fence(gtb, w),
                                        off = function() without_fence(gtb, w)),
                                   params$ext_times)
    skipped <- rw_skip_table(list())
  } else {
    timings <- NULL
    skipped <- rw_skip_table(list(rw_skip_row("bench-fence", "fence", "cuplyr", w, pr$reason)))
  }
  rm(gtb, dfb)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
  list(timings = timings, skipped = skipped, secs = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start, started = t_clock)
})
invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
```

```{r}
#| label: bench-runstats-shift
#| cache: true
#| include: false
# runstats returns left-aligned windows. The main experiment times the raw
# result (the shift to right-aligned happens outside timing); this chunk times
# the same calls with the shift inside, to show how much the shift would have
# added. The "outside" and "inside" samples are interleaved (one of each per
# round, the order alternating), so the difference is a paired one that a change
# of process state between the two halves of a run cannot fake. These are this
# chunk's own samples, separate from the main table's.
bench_runstats <- local({
  t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  t_clock <- Sys.time()
  if (requireNamespace("runstats", quietly = TRUE)) {
    w <- sort(as.numeric(unlist(params$widths)))[2]
    x <- rw_data(as.numeric(params$n_rows))$x
    fns <- rw_functions()
    out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("mean", "sd"), function(stat) {
      f <- fns[[stat]]$runstats
      rw_say("== runstats ", stat, ": shift outside / inside timing, interleaved")
      d <- rw_time_interleaved(list(outside = function() f(x, w),
                                    inside = function() rw_normalize(f(x, w), length(x))),
                               params$times)
      data.frame(stat = stat, shift = d$label, sample = d$sample, ms = d$ms, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  } else {
    out <- NULL
  }
  list(timings = out, secs = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start, started = t_clock)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: bench-cores
#| cache: true
#| include: false
# One-thread timings may depend on which core the scheduler picks when the CPU
# mixes core types (performance and efficiency cores run at different speeds).
# This chunk pins the R process to two logical CPUs of each kind and times one
# single-thread RcppRoll rolling mean on each, one sample per CPU in turn (the
# order reversed every round, as in rw_time_interleaved()): a busy CPU or
# cluster then shows up as two CPUs of one kind that disagree, which the claims
# chunk reports instead of a ratio, and a disturbance of the whole machine hits
# every CPU alike, so it moves the figures more than their ratio. The second CPU of
# a kind is on another L2 cluster when lscpu shows one (the efficiency cores
# share an L2 per cluster of four), else on another core. Before every sample
# the process is pinned and the call runs once untimed on that CPU, so a sample
# never includes a migration or a core waking up. The affinity and the RcppRoll
# thread setting are restored on exit, also after an error. NULL when lscpu or
# taskset is missing. (No cuplyr call here: nothing to probe.)
bench_cores <- local({
  t_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  t_clock <- Sys.time()
  n_rows <- as.numeric(params$n_rows)
  w <- sort(as.numeric(unlist(params$widths)))[2]
  lscpu_cols <- function(cols) tryCatch(suppressWarnings(system2("lscpu", paste0("-e=", cols), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)), error = function(e) character())
  lscpu <- lscpu_cols("CPU,CORE,CACHE,MAXMHZ")
  has_topo <- length(lscpu) > 1L
  if (!has_topo) lscpu <- lscpu_cols("CPU,MAXMHZ")
  taskset <- unname(Sys.which("taskset"))
  out <- NULL
  if (length(lscpu) > 1L && nzchar(taskset) && requireNamespace("RcppRoll", quietly = TRUE)) {
    cpus <- do.call(rbind, lapply(strsplit(trimws(lscpu[-1]), "\\s+"), function(z) {
      if (has_topo) data.frame(cpu = as.integer(z[1]), core = z[2], l2 = strsplit(z[3], ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][3], mhz = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[4])))
      else data.frame(cpu = as.integer(z[1]), core = NA_character_, l2 = NA_character_, mhz = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[2])))
    }))
    cpus <- cpus[!is.na(cpus$cpu) & !is.na(cpus$mhz), ]
    cut <- mean(range(cpus$mhz))
    cpus$kind <- ifelse(cpus$mhz >= cut, "fast", "slow")
    # per kind: the last CPU, then the last one on another L2 (else another core)
    pick_two <- function(k) {
      d <- cpus[cpus$kind == k, ]
      if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
      first <- d[nrow(d), ]
      other <- d[!is.na(d$l2) & d$l2 != first$l2, ]
      apart <- "L2"
      if (!nrow(other)) { other <- d[!is.na(d$core) & d$core != first$core, ]; apart <- "core" }
      if (!nrow(other)) { other <- d[d$cpu != first$cpu, ]; apart <- "cpu" }
      sel <- if (nrow(other)) rbind(first, other[nrow(other), ]) else first
      sel$n_cpus <- nrow(d); sel$kind_mhz <- max(d$mhz)
      sel$apart <- if (nrow(sel) > 1L) apart else NA_character_
      sel
    }
    pins <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("fast", "slow"), pick_two))
    pid <- Sys.getpid()
    mask <- sub("^.*: ", "", system2(taskset, c("-p", pid), stdout = TRUE))
    x <- rw_data(n_rows)$x
    f <- function() RcppRoll::roll_meanr(x, w, fill = NA)
    labs <- as.character(pins$cpu)
    fns <- stats::setNames(rep(list(f), nrow(pins)), labs)
    prep <- stats::setNames(lapply(pins$cpu, function(cpu) function() {
      system2(taskset, c("-cp", cpu, pid), stdout = FALSE)
      invisible(f())
      gc(verbose = FALSE)
    }), labs)
    rw_say("== core placement: ", paste(sprintf("%s cpu %s", pins$kind, pins$cpu), collapse = ", "), ", interleaved")
    restore <- rw_set_threads("RcppRoll", 1)
    d <- tryCatch(rw_time_interleaved(fns, params$times, prepare = prep),
      finally = {
        restore()
        system2(taskset, c("-p", mask, pid), stdout = FALSE)
      })
    m <- match(d$label, labs)
    out <- data.frame(kind = pins$kind[m], cpu = pins$cpu[m], mhz = pins$mhz[m], kind_mhz = pins$kind_mhz[m],
                      n_cpus = pins$n_cpus[m], l2 = pins$l2[m], apart = pins$apart[m], sample = d$sample, ms = d$ms,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  list(timings = out, secs = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_start, started = t_clock)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: data
#| include: false
# Plain data from here on. Nothing below is cached, so the document always
# reflects the current code; only the timing chunks above are expensive.
# polars and DuckDB (bench-engines) are rows of the same tables as every other
# entry: timings, correctness and the extension. The claims chunk says which
# statements stay scoped to the post's packages and which count every engine.
main <- rbind(bench_main$timings, bench_engines$timings)
main <- main[!is.na(main$ms), ]
oh <- bench_overhead$timings
ext <- rbind(bench_ext$ext, bench_engines$ext)
# one block per experiment (grouped first, then the ungrouped sizes by width), the
# entries in the order they were measured within it (the post's, then the engines')
ext <- ext[order(match(ext$experiment, c("grouped mean", "ungrouped mean")), ext$width,
                 match(ext$fn, unique(ext$fn))), ]
rownames(ext) <- NULL
cr <- rbind(bench_main$correctness, bench_engines$correctness)
engine_threads <- bench_engines$threads
thread_info <- bench_main$thread_info
mem_breakdown <- bench_memory$breakdown
if (is.null(mem_breakdown)) mem_breakdown <- data.frame()
mem_finding <- bench_memory$finding
# every cuplyr cell whose probe call fell back to the CPU: not timed, listed here
sk <- rbind(bench_main$skipped, bench_overhead$skipped, bench_ext$skipped,
            bench_memory$skipped, bench_fence$skipped, bench_engines$skipped)
rownames(sk) <- NULL
secs_by_chunk <- c("bench-main" = bench_main$secs, "bench-overhead" = bench_overhead$secs,
                   "bench-ext" = bench_ext$secs, "bench-engines" = bench_engines$secs,
                   "bench-memory" = bench_memory$secs,
                   "bench-fence" = bench_fence$secs, "bench-runstats-shift" = bench_runstats$secs,
                   "bench-cores" = bench_cores$secs)
wall_secs <- sum(secs_by_chunk)
# When each timing chunk ran (its own clock at the start): a cached chunk comes back
# with the time of the render that ran it, so "ran in this render" is a start at or
# after this render's start (render_t0, in the setup chunk).
chunk_started <- vapply(list("bench-main" = bench_main, "bench-overhead" = bench_overhead,
                             "bench-ext" = bench_ext, "bench-engines" = bench_engines,
                             "bench-memory" = bench_memory, "bench-fence" = bench_fence,
                             "bench-runstats-shift" = bench_runstats, "bench-cores" = bench_cores),
                        function(b) if (is.null(b$started)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(b$started), 0)
chunk_ran <- !is.na(chunk_started) & chunk_started >= as.numeric(render_t0)
# The render-time record (render-time.csv, written by the render-time chunk at the
# end of a render in which every timing chunk ran) describes "this code" only when
# (a) its key is this render's cache key, (b) its code key is the md5 of the code of
# the timing chunks now (a code edit reruns that chunk through knitr's own key but
# leaves cache_key unchanged), and (c) every cached result comes from that render:
# each chunk started inside the record's [start - 1 s, end] and at the start time
# the record stored for it. Otherwise the record belongs to other code or results.
bench_code_key <- local({
  tf <- tempfile("rw-code-")
  on.exit(unlink(tf), add = TRUE)
  writeLines(unlist(lapply(names(chunk_started), function(l) c(l, knitr::knit_code$get(l)))), tf)
  unname(tools::md5sum(tf))
})
chunk_starts_txt <- paste(sprintf("%s=%.3f", names(chunk_started), chunk_started), collapse = ";")
rt_path <- file.path(params$out_dir, "render-time.csv")
rt <- if (file.exists(rt_path)) tryCatch(utils::read.csv(rt_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
rt_have <- !is.null(rt) && nrow(rt) == 1L && all(c("key", "code_key", "start_epoch", "end_epoch", "chunk_starts") %in% names(rt))
rt_starts <- if (rt_have) {
  kv <- strsplit(strsplit(as.character(rt$chunk_starts), ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]], "=", fixed = TRUE)
  stats::setNames(as.numeric(vapply(kv, `[`, "", 2)), vapply(kv, `[`, "", 1))
} else numeric()
rt_key_ok <- rt_have && identical(as.character(rt$key), cache_key)
rt_code_ok <- rt_have && identical(as.character(rt$code_key), bench_code_key)
rt_from_it <- rt_have && !anyNA(chunk_started) &&
  all(chunk_started >= rt$start_epoch - 1 & chunk_started <= rt$end_epoch) &&
  setequal(names(rt_starts), names(chunk_started)) &&
  isTRUE(all(abs(rt_starts[names(chunk_started)] - chunk_started) < 0.01))
rt_ok <- rt_key_ok && rt_code_ok && rt_from_it
rt_span <- function(start, end) sprintf("%s to %s on %s", substr(start, 12, 16), substr(end, 12, 16), substr(start, 1, 10))

# one row per (statistic, function, width): median, quartiles, recorded samples
cells <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(main, list(main$stat, main$fn, main$width), drop = TRUE), function(d) {
  data.frame(stat = d$stat[1], fn = d$fn[1], width = d$width[1], med = stats::median(d$ms),
             q25 = unname(stats::quantile(d$ms, .25)), q75 = unname(stats::quantile(d$ms, .75)),
             n = nrow(d), note = d$note[1], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
rownames(cells) <- NULL
cells_key <- paste(cells$stat, cells$fn, cells$width, sep = "\r")
```

```{r}
#| label: hardware
#| include: false
# Versions and hardware, read at render time.
gpu <- tryCatch(cuplyr::gpu_details(), error = function(e) NULL)
cpu_name <- tryCatch(sub(".*: ", "", grep("model name", readLines("/proc/cpuinfo"), value = TRUE)[1]),
                     error = function(e) NA_character_)
cpu_cores <- parallel::detectCores()
quarto_bin <- if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PATH"))) Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PATH") else unname(Sys.which("quarto"))
if (!nzchar(quarto_bin) && file.exists(path.expand("~/.local/bin/quarto"))) quarto_bin <- path.expand("~/.local/bin/quarto")
quarto_ver <- tryCatch(trimws(system2(quarto_bin, "--version", stdout = TRUE)[1]), error = function(e) NA_character_)
gpu_name <- if (!is.null(gpu)) gpu$name else NA_character_
gpu_gb <- if (!is.null(gpu)) round(gpu$total_memory / 1e9) else NA_real_
gpu_cc <- if (!is.null(gpu)) gpu$compute_capability else NA_character_

# Do the packages that were not given a thread control import an OpenMP or TBB
# runtime? `nm -D --undefined-only` on the installed .so (NA: no nm). OpenMP
# symbols (GOMP, omp_) and TBB symbols are counted apart: roll's TBB calls are
# the ones RcppParallel::setThreadOptions() governs, its OpenMP ones are not.
omp_symbols <- function(pkg) {
  libs <- file.path(find.package(pkg), "libs")
  sos <- list.files(libs, pattern = "\\.so$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(sos)) return(c(compiled = FALSE, symbols = 0, tbb = 0))
  nm <- Sys.which("nm")
  if (!nzchar(nm)) return(c(compiled = TRUE, symbols = NA, tbb = NA))
  syms <- unlist(lapply(sos, function(so) suppressWarnings(system2(nm, c("-D", "--undefined-only", shQuote(so)), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE))))
  c(compiled = TRUE, symbols = sum(grepl("GOMP|omp_", syms)), tbb = sum(grepl("tbb", syms, ignore.case = TRUE)))
}
omp <- t(vapply(c("RollingWindow", "slider", "zoo", "runner", "runstats", "roll", "RcppRoll", "data.table"),
                function(p) if (ver[[p]] == "not installed") c(NA, NA, NA) else omp_symbols(p), c(0, 0, 0)))
colnames(omp) <- c("compiled", "symbols", "tbb")

ver_table <- data.frame(
  package = c("R", "cuplyr", "data.table", "roll", "RollingWindow", "runstats", "slider", "RcppRoll",
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
#| include: false
# Formatting and comparison helpers for the prose. Every figure and every
# comparative word in the text goes through these.

# The thresholds behind the comparison words; "Method" states them from here.
th_level <- 0.05   # medians within this fraction of each other are "level" (unless the IQRs are disjoint)
th_trend <- 1.5    # widest / narrowest window median: at least this is "grows", at most its inverse "shrinks"
th_grow <- 1.1     # slider is "growing with the width" above this ratio
th_same <- 0.1     # two calls "cost the same" within this fraction
th_chain <- 0.25   # the narrow-window call is "mostly call chain" within this fraction of the cumsum mutate
th_x <- 1.25       # two figures that "agree" are within this factor of each other
th_core <- 1.2     # a slow core is "measurably" slower than a fast one above this ratio
th_avoid <- 10     # a custom function is clearly slower above this factor
th_front <- 0.25   # rank / entries at most this is "near the front", at least 1 minus it "near the back", "mid-pack" between
th_part <- 0.1     # the runstats shift is "a sizeable part" of the mean figure above this fraction
th_mem <- 0.25     # peak memory is "well inside" the card below this fraction of it
thr_yes <- 1.5     # one-thread / default ratio at which an entry "scales" with threads
thr_no <- 1.15     # ... and at or below which it does not
# three significant digits, trailing zeros kept (4.00, not 4)
fmt_ms <- function(v) vapply(v, function(z) if (is.na(z)) "NA" else sub("\\.$", "", trimws(formatC(signif(z, 3), format = "fg", digits = 3, flag = "#"))), "")
fmt_2 <- function(v) vapply(v, function(z) if (is.na(z)) "NA" else sub("\\.$", "", formatC(z, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")), "")
fmt_1 <- function(v) sprintf("%.1f", v)
fmt_x <- function(r, digits = 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "fx"), r)
fmt_xr <- function(r) fmt_x(r, if (r >= 10) 0 else 1)
fmt_pct <- function(f, digits = 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%%"), 100 * f)
fmt_int <- function(v) formatC(v, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
fmt_mb <- function(b) sprintf("%s MB", formatC(b / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))
fmt_rows <- function(n) vapply(n, function(z) {
  k <- log10(z)
  if (z >= 1e3 && abs(k - round(k)) < 1e-9) sprintf("1e%d", as.integer(round(k))) else fmt_int(z)
}, "")
ms_s <- function(v) ifelse(v >= 1000, paste(fmt_ms(v / 1000), "s"), paste(fmt_ms(v), "ms"))
# "4.00 ms", or "not timed" for a cell that was skipped or failed
ms_nt <- function(v) ifelse(is.na(v), "not timed", paste(fmt_ms(v), "ms"))
# a signed difference in ms, or nothing when either side is missing
ms_delta <- function(a, b, vs = "") if (anyNA(c(a, b))) "" else sprintf(" (%+.2f ms%s)", a - b, vs)
# whole seconds first, so a duration just under a whole minute cannot read as 60 s
fmt_dur <- function(secs) vapply(round(secs), function(z) {
  m <- floor(z / 60)
  if (m < 1) sprintf("%.0f s", z) else sprintf("%d min %02d s", as.integer(m), as.integer(z - 60 * m))
}, "")
num_words <- c("zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten",
               "eleven", "twelve", "thirteen", "fourteen", "fifteen", "sixteen", "seventeen",
               "eighteen", "nineteen", "twenty")
words <- function(n) ifelse(!is.na(n) & n >= 0 & n <= 20 & n == round(n), num_words[n + 1], as.character(n))
ord_words <- c("first", "second", "third", "fourth", "fifth", "sixth", "seventh", "eighth", "ninth", "tenth")
ordinal <- function(n) if (n <= 10) ord_words[n] else paste0(n, "th")
times_word <- function(n) if (n == 1) "once" else if (n == 2) "twice" else paste(words(n), "times")
plural <- function(n, one, many = paste0(one, "s")) if (n == 1) one else many
code <- function(x) paste0("`", x, "`")
join_and <- function(x, conj = "and") {
  x <- as.character(x)
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0L) "" else if (n == 1L) x else if (n == 2L) paste(x, collapse = paste0(" ", conj, " ")) else
    paste0(paste(x[-n], collapse = ", "), " ", conj, " ", x[n])
}
cap1 <- function(s) paste0(toupper(substr(s, 1, 1)), substring(s, 2))
range_x <- function(v, digits = 1) {
  r <- range(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  a <- sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), r[1]); b <- sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), r[2])
  if (a == b) paste0(a, "x") else paste0(a, "-", b, "x")
}
range_num <- function(v, digits = 2) {
  r <- range(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  a <- sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), r[1]); b <- sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), r[2])
  if (a == b) a else paste0(a, "-", b)
}
# a range of times as "lo-hi ms" (or s), two significant digits, whole numbers from 100
fmt_rng_one <- function(v) if (v >= 100) formatC(round(v), format = "d") else fmt_2(v)
range_ms <- function(v) {
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if (!length(v)) return("NA")
  unit <- if (max(v) >= 1000) "s" else "ms"
  if (unit == "s") v <- v / 1000
  a <- if (unit == "s") fmt_2(min(v)) else fmt_rng_one(min(v))
  b <- if (unit == "s") fmt_2(max(v)) else fmt_rng_one(max(v))
  paste(if (a == b) a else paste0(a, "-", b), unit)
}
slash <- function(v) paste(fmt_ms(v), collapse = " / ")
cmp_than <- function(r, hi = 1 + th_level) {      # r = a / b, a and b both times
  if (r >= hi) "slower than" else if (r <= 1 / hi) "faster than" else "level with"
}

# Lookups into the main results
cell_i <- function(stat, fn, width) match(paste(stat, fn, width, sep = "\r"), cells_key)
med <- function(stat, fn, width) cells$med[cell_i(stat, fn, width)]
med_w <- function(stat, fn, ws = widths) vapply(ws, function(w) med(stat, fn, w), 0)
trip <- function(stat, fn, width) {
  i <- cell_i(stat, fn, width)
  c(med = cells$med[i], q25 = cells$q25[i], q75 = cells$q75[i])
}
nsamp <- function(stat, fn, width) cells$n[cell_i(stat, fn, width)]
has_cell <- function(stat, fn, width) !is.na(cell_i(stat, fn, width))
ext_i <- function(experiment, fn, width) which(ext$experiment == experiment & ext$fn == fn & ext$width == width)[1]
ext_med <- function(experiment, fn, width) ext$median_ms[ext_i(experiment, fn, width)]
ext_trip <- function(experiment, fn, width) {
  i <- ext_i(experiment, fn, width)
  c(med = ext$median_ms[i], q25 = ext$q25_ms[i], q75 = ext$q75_ms[i])
}

# a versus b (both c(med, q25, q75), times): lower is faster. Within 5% of each
# other the medians are called level unless the interquartile ranges are
# disjoint, which makes it "slightly" faster or slower.
verdict <- function(a, b, tol = th_level) {
  if (anyNA(c(a[["med"]], b[["med"]]))) return(NA_character_)
  r <- a[["med"]] / b[["med"]]
  if (r < 1 - tol) return("faster")
  if (r > 1 + tol) return("slower")
  if (a[["q75"]] < b[["q25"]]) return("slightly faster")
  if (b[["q75"]] < a[["q25"]]) return("slightly slower")
  "level"
}
is_faster <- function(v) v %in% c("faster", "slightly faster")
is_slower <- function(v) v %in% c("slower", "slightly slower")
vocab_basic <- c(faster = "faster", `slightly faster` = "slightly faster", level = "level",
                 slower = "slower", `slightly slower` = "slightly slower")
vocab_ahead <- c(faster = "ahead", `slightly faster` = "slightly ahead", level = "level",
                 slower = "behind", `slightly slower` = "slightly behind")
# "faster at all three widths" / "faster at w=101 and w=1001, slower at w=11"
runs_txt <- function(v, ws = widths, vocab = vocab_basic) {
  keep <- !is.na(v)
  v <- v[keep]; ws <- ws[keep]
  if (!length(v)) return("not comparable")
  kinds <- unique(v)
  if (length(kinds) == 1L) {
    where <- if (length(ws) == length(widths)) paste("all", words(length(ws)), "widths") else join_and(paste0("w=", ws))
    return(sprintf("%s at %s", vocab[[kinds]], where))
  }
  paste(vapply(kinds, function(k) sprintf("%s at %s", vocab[[k]], join_and(paste0("w=", ws[v == k]))), ""), collapse = ", ")
}
# statistics with the same verdict pattern are described together
pattern_txt <- function(df, vocab = vocab_basic) {
  stats <- unique(df$stat)
  pats <- vapply(stats, function(s) {
    d <- df[df$stat == s, ]
    paste(d$v[match(widths, d$width)], collapse = "|")
  }, "")
  groups <- split(stats, factor(pats, levels = unique(pats)))
  paste(vapply(names(groups), function(p) {
    v <- strsplit(p, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    v[v == "NA"] <- NA
    sprintf("%s: %s", join_and(groups[[p]]), runs_txt(v, widths, vocab))
  }, ""), collapse = "; ")
}
# median per statistic as "mean 0.87, sum 0.87, min 0.97 ..." where equal
# figures share a label ("10.4 min/max")
merge_equal <- function(fn, stats, width = w_mid) {
  vals <- fmt_ms(vapply(stats, function(s) med(s, fn, width), 0))
  runs <- rle(vals)
  ends <- cumsum(runs$lengths); starts <- ends - runs$lengths + 1
  parts <- vapply(seq_along(runs$values), function(i) paste(runs$values[i], paste(stats[starts[i]:ends[i]], collapse = "/")), "")
  parts[1] <- sub("^(\\S+)", "\\1 ms", parts[1])
  paste(parts, collapse = ", ")
}
```

```{r}
# Where the code the findings talk about lives, read from the checkout.
root <- normalizePath(params$root)

}
ln_window <- grep_lines("R/mutate.R", "push_op(result, ast_window(")[1]
```

```{r}
#| label: claims
#| include: false
# Everything the prose says that depends on the numbers: the quantities, and
# the words that compare them. If a fresh run reverses a conclusion, the
# sentences built here say so.
stat_order <- c("mean", "sum", "min", "max", "sd", "median")
stats_main <- intersect(stat_order, unique(cells$stat))

# where the cached timing results come from, for the wall-time line at the top:
# one run (this render, or the cold render of the record) or several
fmt_clock <- function(t) format(as.POSIXct(t, origin = "1970-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
# The timing chunks follow each other in the document with nothing slow between
# them, so in one run each starts within seconds of the previous one's end (30 s
# allowed); a start anywhere else (or not recorded) begins another run.
ch_end <- chunk_started + secs_by_chunk
run_id <- cumsum(c(TRUE, !(abs(chunk_started[-1] - ch_end[-length(ch_end)]) <= 30) %in% TRUE))
n_runs <- length(unique(run_id))
run_desc <- vapply(split(names(chunk_started), run_id), function(l) {
  span <- if (length(l) == 1L) l else sprintf("%s to %s", l[1], l[length(l)])
  if (all(chunk_ran[l])) sprintf("%s in this render", span) else if (is.na(chunk_started[l[1]])) sprintf("%s at an unrecorded time", span) else
    sprintf("%s in an earlier run (%s started at %s)", span, l[1], fmt_clock(chunk_started[l[1]]))
}, "")
wall_origin_txt <- if (all(chunk_ran)) {
  "every timing chunk ran in this render, so these are the elapsed times of this render's run"
} else if (rt_ok) {
  sprintf("the elapsed times of the complete cold render from %s, which produced every cached result", rt_span(rt$render_start, rt$render_end))
} else if (n_runs == 1L) {
  sprintf("the elapsed times of the one earlier run that produced every cached result (%s started at %s)", names(chunk_started)[1], fmt_clock(chunk_started[1]))
} else {
  sprintf("the cached results come from %s runs, so this sum is not the time of one run: %s", words(n_runs), join_and(run_desc))
}
# the timed work of a cold run of this code, for "How to render"
cold_work_txt <- if (all(chunk_ran) || rt_ok) sprintf("A cold run (empty cache) took %s of timed work on this machine", fmt_dur(wall_secs)) else
  "How much timed work a cold run (empty cache) of this code takes is not known from this render (see the render time above)"

# ---- which entries a statement counts (F73) --------------------------------------------
# polars and DuckDB are added entries; the post compared its own packages. Every
# statement about who is fastest in the post (cpu_bases and what is built on it:
# the headline verdict, RcppRoll's lead, the one-thread exceptions), about roll,
# slider, zoo, runner and the custom functions, and about the threads of each
# package (the post's thread table rows, unctl, the omp check) stays scoped to
# `post_fns`, so adding an engine cannot change a conclusion about the post's
# packages. Every statement about where cuplyr lands (vs_text, rank_of and
# rank_pos, the sd ranking, the grouped and ungrouped extension sentences, Net,
# and the section on the engines) counts every entry, engines included.
eng_base <- c("polars", "DuckDB")
eng_labels <- c(eng_base, vapply(eng_base, rw_one_thread_label, ""))
post_fns <- setdiff(unique(cells$fn), c(eng_labels, "cuplyr", "cuplyr (froll alias)"))
n_st <- length(stats_main)
rows_txt <- fmt_rows(n_rows); ext_txt <- fmt_rows(ext_rows)
groups_txt <- fmt_rows(n_groups); grp_rows_txt <- fmt_rows(group_rows)
small_rows <- bench_overhead$small_rows; small_txt <- fmt_rows(small_rows)
tol <- eval(formals(rw_compare)$tol)
tol_txt <- format(tol, scientific = TRUE)
dt_ver <- unname(ver["data.table"]); dt_minor <- sub("^([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+).*$", "\\1", dt_ver)
ti <- stats::setNames(thread_info$version, thread_info$item)
n_dt_threads <- ti[["data.table getDTthreads()"]]
n_rr_threads <- ti[["RcppRoll roll_threads()"]]
n_roll_threads <- ti[["RcppParallel defaultNumThreads()"]]
omp_env <- ti[["OMP_NUM_THREADS (env)"]]

# ---- cuplyr cells that were not timed (CPU fallback) ------------------------------
# Every cuplyr cell was probed before timing (rw_native_probe()); the ones that
# would run on the CPU fallback are in `sk` and have no timing anywhere.
sk_main <- sk[sk$chunk == "bench-main", ]
n_skip <- nrow(sk); n_skip_main <- nrow(sk_main)
skip_stats <- unique(sk_main$stat[grepl("^cuplyr", sk_main$fn)])
median_skipped <- "median" %in% skip_stats
skip_why <- function(stat) if (stat == "median")
  sprintf("no GPU path (cuplyr's roll_median() runs on the CPU fallback; cudf %s has no rolling MEDIAN)", cudf_ver_short) else
  "no GPU path in this run (the probe call fell back to the CPU)"
# the widths at which a main-experiment cuplyr entry was skipped
skip_widths <- function(stat, fn) sort(sk_main$width[sk_main$stat == stat & sk_main$fn == fn])
skip_note <- function(stat, fn = "cuplyr") {
  ws <- skip_widths(stat, fn)
  at <- if (length(ws) && length(ws) < length(widths)) paste0(" at ", join_and(paste0("w=", ws))) else ""
  paste0("not timed", at, ": ", skip_why(stat))
}
skip_groups <- unique(sk[c("chunk", "stat", "fn")])
skip_summary <- if (!n_skip) "" else join_and(vapply(seq_len(nrow(skip_groups)), function(i) {
  g <- skip_groups[i, ]
  d <- sk[sk$chunk == g$chunk & sk$stat == g$stat & sk$fn == g$fn, ]
  at <- if (all(is.na(d$width))) "" else if (nrow(d) == length(widths) && g$chunk == "bench-main") paste(", all", words(nrow(d)), "widths") else paste0(", ", join_and(paste0("w=", d$width[!is.na(d$width)])))
  sprintf("%s (%s%s)", code(g$fn), g$stat, at)
}, ""))
sk_show <- sk
sk_show$reason <- substr(gsub("\\s+", " ", sk$reason), 1, 150)
sk_csv <- cbind(sk, note = rep(if (n_skip) "not timed: the probe call fell back to the CPU" else character(), n_skip))
only_native_txt <- if (!n_skip) "Every cuplyr entry is computation only, and none fell back to the CPU in this run." else
  paste0("Every cuplyr entry that is timed is computation only. Cells that run on the CPU fallback (download, an R loop, re-upload) are not timed: ", skip_summary, ".",
         if (median_skipped) " The median table and plot carry a note instead of a number for cuplyr." else "")

# ---- run configuration -------------------------------------------------------
cfg_defaults <- tryCatch(rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter("rolling-window.qmd")$params, error = function(e) NULL)
cfg_names <- c("n_rows", "widths", "times", "times_custom", "cell_budget", "probe_limit", "group_rows",
               "n_groups", "group_width", "ext_rows", "ext_times", "stats")
cfg_diff <- if (is.null(cfg_defaults)) character() else Filter(nzchar, vapply(cfg_names, function(nm) {
  a <- sort(as.character(unlist(params[[nm]]))); b <- sort(as.character(unlist(cfg_defaults[[nm]])))
  # numbers compare as numbers (the default 1e7 is read from YAML as text)
  same <- identical(a, b) || (!anyNA(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(c(a, b)))) && isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(a), as.numeric(b))))
  if (same) "" else sprintf("%s = %s (default %s)", nm, paste(unlist(params[[nm]]), collapse = " / "), paste(unlist(cfg_defaults[[nm]]), collapse = " / "))
}, ""))
cfg_txt <- if (!length(cfg_diff)) "These are the defaults of the document, with no parameter overridden" else
  paste0("Parameters differing from the defaults: ", join_and(cfg_diff))

# ---- threads: what each setting actually did ------------------------------------
cells_w <- cells[cells$width == w_mid, ]
grp_lab <- "grouped mean"; ung_lab <- paste(ext_txt, "ungrouped mean")
thr_all <- rbind(
  data.frame(kind = "main", where = paste0(rows_txt, " rows, w=", w_mid), statistic = cells_w$stat, fn = cells_w$fn,
             med = cells_w$med, q25 = cells_w$q25, q75 = cells_w$q75, n = cells_w$n, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  { e <- ext[ext$width == w_mid, ]
    data.frame(kind = ifelse(e$experiment == "grouped mean", "grouped", "ungrouped"),
               where = paste0(ifelse(e$experiment == "grouped mean", grp_lab, ung_lab), ", w=", w_mid),
               statistic = "mean", fn = e$fn, med = e$median_ms, q25 = e$q25_ms, q75 = e$q75_ms, n = e$times,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE) })
# the thread count of an engine is the one read back from it (engine-threads.csv)
engine_default_threads <- function(e) engine_threads$threads[engine_threads$engine == e & engine_threads$config == "default"]
engine_one_threads <- function(e) engine_threads$threads[engine_threads$engine == e & engine_threads$config == "1 thread"]
default_threads <- function(fn) {
  if (fn %in% eng_base) return(paste0(engine_default_threads(fn), if (fn == "DuckDB") " (current_setting)" else " (polars_info)"))
  pkg <- rw_threaded_pkg(fn)
  if (is.na(pkg)) return(NA_character_)
  switch(pkg, data.table = paste0(n_dt_threads, " (setDTthreads)"), RcppRoll = paste0(n_rr_threads, " (OpenMP)"),
         roll = paste0(n_roll_threads, " (RcppParallel)"))
}
thr_build <- function(ta) {
  t <- do.call(rbind, lapply(grep("1 thread\\)$", ta$fn), function(i) {
    b <- ta[i, ]
    a <- ta[ta$where == b$where & ta$statistic == b$statistic & ta$fn == rw_base_label(b$fn), ]
    if (nrow(a) != 1L) return(NULL)
    ratio <- b$med / a$med
    data.frame(kind = b$kind, where = b$where, statistic = b$statistic, entry = a$fn, threads = default_threads(a$fn),
               default_med = a$med, default_q25 = a$q25, default_q75 = a$q75, one_med = b$med, one_q25 = b$q25,
               one_q75 = b$q75, ratio = ratio, n_default = a$n, n_one = b$n,
               class = if (ratio >= thr_yes) "scales" else if (ratio <= thr_no) "flat" else "weak", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  t <- t[order(match(t$kind, c("main", "grouped", "ungrouped")), t$entry, match(t$statistic, c(stat_order, "custom"))), ]
  rownames(t) <- NULL
  t
}
# the post's packages (every statement about them below uses `thr`), and the engines
thr <- thr_build(thr_all[!thr_all$fn %in% eng_labels, ])
thr_eng <- thr_build(thr_all[thr_all$fn %in% eng_labels, ])
thr_both <- rbind(thr, thr_eng)
thr_both <- thr_both[order(match(thr_both$kind, c("main", "grouped", "ungrouped")), thr_both$entry, match(thr_both$statistic, c(stat_order, "custom"))), ]
rownames(thr_both) <- NULL
thr_tab <- function(thr) data.frame(
  experiment = thr$where, statistic = thr$statistic, entry = thr$entry, default_threads = thr$threads,
  default_ms = sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", fmt_ms(thr$default_med), fmt_ms(thr$default_q25), fmt_ms(thr$default_q75)),
  one_thread_ms = sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", fmt_ms(thr$one_med), fmt_ms(thr$one_q25), fmt_ms(thr$one_q75)),
  ratio = sprintf("%.2f", thr$ratio),
  scales = ifelse(thr$class == "scales", sprintf("yes (%s slower at 1 thread)", fmt_x(thr$ratio)),
                  ifelse(thr$class == "flat", "no", "weakly")), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
thr_table <- thr_tab(thr_both)
samples_txt <- function(n) { r <- range(n); if (r[1] == r[2]) as.character(r[1]) else paste0(r[1], "-", r[2]) }
thr_main_std <- thr_both[thr_both$kind == "main" & thr_both$statistic != "custom", ]
thr_main_cus <- thr_both[thr_both$kind == "main" & thr_both$statistic == "custom", ]
n_thr_std <- samples_txt(c(thr_main_std$n_default, thr_main_std$n_one))
n_thr_cus <- samples_txt(c(thr_main_cus$n_default, thr_main_cus$n_one))
n_thr_ext <- samples_txt(c(thr_both$n_default[thr_both$kind != "main"], thr_both$n_one[thr_both$kind != "main"]))
within_pct <- function(r) fmt_pct(max(abs(r - 1)))

froll_one <- function(entry, statistic) {
  if (entry == "data.table") code(paste0("froll", statistic))
  else if (entry == "data.table (exact)") code("frollsum(algo = \"exact\")")
  else if (entry == "data.table::frollapply") code("frollapply") else code(entry)
}
froll_group <- function(rows) {
  plain <- rows$statistic[rows$entry == "data.table"]
  others <- vapply(which(rows$entry != "data.table"), function(i) froll_one(rows$entry[i], rows$statistic[i]), "")
  join_and(c(if (length(plain)) code(paste0("froll", paste(plain, collapse = "/"))), others))
}
scaled_group <- function(rows) {
  join_and(vapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) sprintf("%s (%s)", froll_one(rows$entry[i], rows$statistic[i]), fmt_x(rows$ratio[i])), ""))
}

rr <- thr[thr$entry == "RcppRoll" & thr$kind == "main", ]
rr_ung <- thr[thr$entry == "RcppRoll" & thr$kind == "ungrouped", ]
rr_scales <- nrow(rr) > 0 && all(rr$class == "scales")
rr_runs <- if (rr_scales) "runs on" else "is set to"
rr_claim <- if (rr_scales) sprintf("scales with them: %s slower at one thread for every statistic at w=%s", range_x(rr$ratio, 0), w_mid) else
  if (all(rr$class == "flat")) sprintf("does not use them: its one-thread control is within %s of the default for every statistic at w=%s", within_pct(rr$ratio), w_mid) else
  sprintf("scales for %s but not for %s at w=%s", join_and(rr$statistic[rr$class == "scales"]), join_and(rr$statistic[rr$class != "scales"]), w_mid)
rr_reading <- if (rr_scales) sprintf("scales on every statistic (%s slower at one thread at w=%s%s)", range_x(rr$ratio),
                                      w_mid, if (nrow(rr_ung)) sprintf("; %s at %s rows", fmt_x(rr_ung$ratio[1]), ext_txt) else "") else
  sprintf("does not scale on every statistic: %s", rr_claim)

dt_rows <- thr[grepl("^data\\.table", thr$entry) & thr$kind == "main", ]
dt_flat <- dt_rows[dt_rows$class == "flat", ]
dt_scale <- dt_rows[dt_rows$class == "scales", ]
dt_weak <- dt_rows[dt_rows$class == "weak", ]
dt_by <- thr[thr$kind == "grouped" & grepl("^data\\.table", thr$entry), ]
dt_ung <- thr[thr$kind == "ungrouped" & thr$entry == "data.table", ]
by_flat <- nrow(dt_by) > 0 && all(dt_by$class == "flat")
dt_within <- within_pct(c(dt_flat$ratio, if (by_flat) dt_by$ratio))
dt_lead <- if (nrow(dt_flat)) sprintf("data.table's %s%s ran effectively on one thread", froll_group(dt_flat),
                                      if (by_flat) paste0(" and its ", code("by="), " evaluation") else "") else
  "data.table's calls all scaled with threads"
dt_only <- if (nrow(dt_scale)) sprintf("Only %s scale.", scaled_group(dt_scale)) else "None of its calls scaled."
dt_weak_txt <- if (nrow(dt_weak)) sprintf(" Borderline (ratio between %s and %s): %s.", thr_no, thr_yes, scaled_group(dt_weak)) else ""
dt_scale_names <- if (nrow(dt_scale)) join_and(vapply(seq_len(nrow(dt_scale)), function(i) froll_one(dt_scale$entry[i], dt_scale$statistic[i]), "")) else "none of its calls"
dt_scale_sentence <- if (nrow(dt_scale)) sprintf("data.table's %s scale", dt_scale_names) else "none of data.table's calls scaled"
dt_reading <- if (nrow(dt_scale)) sprintf("scales only for %s.", scaled_group(dt_scale)) else "does not scale for any of its calls."
dt_flat_reading <- if (nrow(dt_flat)) sprintf("%s (ratio %s)%s do not%s", froll_group(dt_flat), range_num(dt_flat$ratio),
                                              if (by_flat) sprintf(" and the grouped %s call (%s)", code("by = g"), sprintf("%.2f", dt_by$ratio[1])) else "",
                                              ": that is the figure the grouped comparison below depends on.") else ""

roll_rows <- thr[thr$entry == "roll" & thr$kind == "main", ]
roll_ung <- thr[thr$entry == "roll" & thr$kind == "ungrouped", ]
roll_flat <- nrow(roll_rows) > 0 && all(roll_rows$class == "flat")
roll_lead <- if (roll_flat) "roll ran effectively on one thread" else sprintf("roll used extra threads for %s", join_and(roll_rows$statistic[roll_rows$class != "flat"]))
roll_claim <- if (roll_flat) sprintf("for every statistic (1-thread vs default within %s at w=%s), although RcppParallel reports %s available threads",
                                      within_pct(roll_rows$ratio), w_mid, n_roll_threads) else
  sprintf("(ratio %s at w=%s); RcppParallel reports %s available threads", range_num(roll_rows$ratio), w_mid, n_roll_threads)
roll_reading <- if (roll_flat) sprintf("does not scale on any statistic (ratio %s)%s.", range_num(roll_rows$ratio),
                                       if (nrow(roll_ung)) sprintf(", including at %s rows", ext_txt) else "") else
  sprintf("scales on %s (ratio %s).", join_and(roll_rows$statistic[roll_rows$class == "scales"]), range_num(roll_rows$ratio))

n_omp <- omp[["roll", "symbols"]]
roll_omp_txt <- if (!is.na(n_omp) && n_omp > 0) {
  paste0("(", code("roll.so"), " also imports ", words(n_omp), " OpenMP runtime ", plural(n_omp, "symbol"), " (", code("GOMP*"), ", ", code("omp_*"), "), which ", code("setThreadOptions()"),
         " does not govern; the default online vector workers used here are sequential loops, and only roll's offline workers are RcppParallel workers",
         if (roll_flat) ", so the one-thread reading holds.)" else ", which may explain the scaling.)")
} else ""
unctl <- c("RollingWindow", "slider", "zoo", "runner")
unctl <- unctl[ver[unctl] != "not installed"]
unctl_clean <- !anyNA(omp[unctl, c("symbols", "tbb")]) && all(omp[unctl, c("symbols", "tbb")] == 0)
runstats_pure <- ver[["runstats"]] != "not installed" && identical(unname(omp["runstats", "compiled"]), 0)
nm_ok <- nzchar(Sys.which("nm"))
unctl_check <- if (!nm_ok) {
  "Their compiled code could not be checked here (no `nm`); I treat them as single-threaded, which is an assumption, not a timing."
} else if (unctl_clean) {
  sprintf("Their compiled code imports no OpenMP or TBB runtime symbol (%s on the installed shared object, run by this document)%s. I treat them as single-threaded; that is a static check, not a timing.",
          code("nm -D --undefined-only"), if (runstats_pure) " and runstats is pure R" else "")
} else {
  bad <- unctl[!is.na(omp[unctl, "symbols"]) & (omp[unctl, "symbols"] > 0 | omp[unctl, "tbb"] > 0)]
  sprintf("But the compiled code of %s imports OpenMP or TBB runtime symbols (%s), so they may use threads that this report did not control.",
          join_and(bad), code("nm -D --undefined-only"))
}

# ---- who is fastest ---------------------------------------------------------------
cpu_bases <- function(stat) {
  f <- unique(cells$fn[cells$stat == stat])
  f <- f[f %in% post_fns]   # the post's packages only: an added engine never becomes "the fastest package"
  f[!grepl("1 thread|^cuplyr|exact|::", f)]
}
view_def <- function(stat, width) { b <- cpu_bases(stat); stats::setNames(vapply(b, function(e) med(stat, e, width), 0), b) }
view_1t <- function(stat, width) {
  b <- cpu_bases(stat)
  stats::setNames(vapply(b, function(e) med(stat, if (!is.na(rw_threaded_pkg(e))) rw_one_thread_label(e) else e, width), 0), b)
}
win_def <- vapply(stats_main, function(s) names(which.min(view_def(s, w_mid))), "")
win_1t <- vapply(stats_main, function(s) names(which.min(view_1t(s, w_mid))), "")
n_dt_wins <- sum(win_1t == "data.table")
headline_verdict <- if (n_dt_wins == n_st) "holds" else if (n_dt_wins == n_st - 1L) "holds (with an exception, below)" else
  if (n_dt_wins > n_st / 2) "holds only in part" else "does not hold"
rr_default_wins <- win_def == "RcppRoll"
lead_clause <- if (all(rr_default_wins) && rr_scales) sprintf("comes from its %s OpenMP threads", n_rr_threads) else
  if (all(rr_default_wins)) "is not explained by its threads (its one-thread control is about as fast)" else
  sprintf("is limited to %s of %s statistics", words(sum(rr_default_wins)), words(n_st))
rr_leader <- if (all(rr_default_wins)) "RcppRoll was the fastest package in every statistic" else
  sprintf("RcppRoll was the fastest package in %s of %s statistics", words(sum(rr_default_wins)), words(n_st))
rr_default_list <- paste(vapply(stats_main, function(s) {
  if (win_def[[s]] == "RcppRoll") sprintf("%s %s ms (data.table %s)", s, fmt_ms(med(s, "RcppRoll", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med(s, "data.table", w_mid)))
  else sprintf("%s %s ms, but %s was faster (%s)", s, fmt_ms(med(s, "RcppRoll", w_mid)), win_def[[s]], fmt_ms(min(view_def(s, w_mid))))
}, ""), collapse = ", ")
rr1_list <- join_and(vapply(stats_main, function(s) paste(s, fmt_ms(med(s, "RcppRoll (1 thread)", w_mid))), ""))
rr1_ratio <- sprintf("(%s %s)", range_x(rr$ratio, 0), if (all(rr$ratio > 1)) "slower" else "different")

dt1_rr1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats_main, function(s) data.frame(stat = s, width = widths,
  v = vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip(s, "data.table (1 thread)", w), trip(s, "RcppRoll (1 thread)", w)), ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
dt1_rr1_txt <- pattern_txt(dt1_rr1)
dt_single_stats <- intersect(c("mean", "sum", "min", "max"), dt_flat$statistic[dt_flat$entry == "data.table"])
dt_single_txt <- if (length(dt_single_stats)) sprintf(" (whose %s calls are single-threaded anyway)", paste(dt_single_stats, collapse = "/")) else ""
dt1_med <- slash(med_w("median", "data.table (1 thread)")); rr1_med <- slash(med_w("median", "RcppRoll (1 thread)"))
rw_med <- slash(med_w("median", "RollingWindow"))
rw_v <- vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip("median", "RollingWindow", w), trip("median", "data.table (1 thread)", w)), "")
rw_med_txt <- runs_txt(rw_v, widths, vocab_ahead)
dt_med_ratio <- med("median", "data.table", w_mid) / med("median", "RcppRoll", w_mid)
dt_med_txt <- sprintf("%s %s threads data.table's median (%s) is %s the %s-thread RcppRoll (%s).",
  if (dt_med_ratio >= 1 + th_level) "Even with its" else "With its", n_dt_threads, ms_s(med("median", "data.table", w_mid)),
  if (dt_med_ratio >= 1 + th_level) paste("about", fmt_xr(dt_med_ratio), "slower than") else if (dt_med_ratio <= 1 / (1 + th_level)) paste("about", fmt_xr(1 / dt_med_ratio), "faster than") else "level with",
  n_rr_threads, ms_s(med("median", "RcppRoll", w_mid)))
exc <- stats_main[win_1t != "data.table"]
exc_txt <- if (!length(exc)) sprintf("At equal, one-thread conditions data.table is the fastest at w=%s in every statistic.", w_mid) else
  paste(vapply(exc, function(s) {
    v <- sort(view_1t(s, w_mid))
    lab <- function(e) ifelse(is.na(vapply(e, rw_threaded_pkg, "")), e, paste("one-thread", e))
    top <- head(names(v), 3)
    sprintf("%s is the exception: %s (%s) is fastest, then %s%s.", s, lab(top[1]), ms_s(v[[1]]),
            join_and(sprintf("%s (%s)", lab(top[-1]), fmt_ms(v[top[-1]]))),
            if (s == "sd") "; the post had no data.table sd" else "")
  }, ""), collapse = " ")

# ---- roll, slider, zoo, runner, custom ---------------------------------------------
roll_ms <- merge_equal("roll", stats_main)
beats <- function(stat, dt_fn, other) is_faster(vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip(stat, dt_fn, w), trip(stat, other, w)), ""))
dt_beats_roll_def <- all(vapply(c("median", "sd"), function(s) all(beats(s, "data.table", "roll")), TRUE))
dt_beats_roll_1t <- all(vapply(c("median", "sd"), function(s) all(beats(s, "data.table (1 thread)", "roll (1 thread)")), TRUE))
roll_vs_dt_txt <- if (dt_beats_roll_def && dt_beats_roll_1t) {
  sprintf("data.table %s now has %s and %s and beats it on those (at one thread, too: median %s vs %s ms, sd %s vs %s)",
    dt_minor, code("frollmedian"), code("frollsd"), fmt_ms(med("median", "data.table (1 thread)", w_mid)),
    fmt_ms(med("median", "roll (1 thread)", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sd", "data.table (1 thread)", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sd", "roll (1 thread)", w_mid)))
} else if (dt_beats_roll_def) {
  sprintf("data.table %s beats it on median and sd at default settings, but not at one thread", dt_minor)
} else {
  sprintf("data.table %s does not beat it on both median and sd in this run (median %s vs %s ms, sd %s vs %s)", dt_minor,
    fmt_ms(med("median", "data.table", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("median", "roll", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sd", "data.table", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sd", "roll", w_mid)))
}
roll_ran_txt <- if (roll_flat) "roll ran on one thread for every statistic." else sprintf("roll used extra threads for %s.", join_and(roll_rows$statistic[roll_rows$class != "flat"]))

fn_stats <- function(fn) { s <- unique(cells$stat[cells$fn == fn]); intersect(stat_order, s) }
at_w <- function(fn, w, stats = fn_stats(fn)) vapply(stats, function(s) med(s, fn, w), 0)
slower_than_dt <- function(fn) {
  s <- intersect(fn_stats(fn), stats_main)
  all(vapply(s, function(st) is_slower(verdict(trip(st, fn, w_mid), trip(st, "data.table", w_mid))), TRUE))
}
slider_grows <- all(vapply(fn_stats("slider"), function(s) med(s, "slider", w_hi) > th_grow * med(s, "slider", w_lo), TRUE))
slider_txt <- sprintf("slider (%s at w=%s; %s at w=%s, %s at w=%s%s) %s", range_ms(at_w("slider", w_mid)), w_mid,
  range_ms(at_w("slider", w_lo)), w_lo, range_ms(at_w("slider", w_hi)), w_hi, if (slider_grows) ", growing with the width" else "",
  if (slower_than_dt("slider")) "is for custom alignment, not speed" else "is not slower than data.table in every statistic")
zoo_runner_slow <- slower_than_dt("zoo") && slower_than_dt("runner")
zoo_runner_txt <- sprintf("zoo (%s) and runner (%s at w=%s, %s at w=%s) %s", range_ms(at_w("zoo", w_mid)),
  range_ms(at_w("runner", w_mid)), w_mid, range_ms(at_w("runner", w_hi)), w_hi,
  if (zoo_runner_slow) "are slow" else "are not slower than data.table in every statistic")
cus_fa <- med("custom", "data.table::frollapply", w_mid); cus_fa1 <- med("custom", "data.table::frollapply (1 thread)", w_mid)
cus_zoo <- med_w("custom", "zoo::rollapply")
cus_zoo_grows <- length(na.omit(cus_zoo)) > 1 && all(diff(na.omit(cus_zoo)) > 0)
opt_equiv <- med_w("sum", "data.table")
cus_grow_txt <- if (cus_zoo_grows) "growing with the width" else "not growing with the width"
cus_verdict <- if (min(c(cus_fa, cus_zoo), na.rm = TRUE) > th_avoid * max(opt_equiv)) "Avoid them." else "They are not clearly slower in this run."

# ---- where cuplyr lands --------------------------------------------------------------
cup_native <- c("mean", "sum", "min", "max")
cup_native <- intersect(cup_native, stats_main)
# a cell that was not timed (skipped or failed) is left out of the range
nat_txt <- paste(vapply(widths, function(w) {
  v <- vapply(cup_native, function(s) med(s, "cuplyr", w), 0)
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if (!length(v)) return("not timed")
  a <- fmt_2(min(v)); b <- fmt_2(max(v)); if (a == b) a else paste0(a, "-", b)
}, ""), collapse = " / ")
widths_slash <- paste(widths, collapse = " / ")
excl_cup <- c("cuplyr", "cuplyr (froll alias)")
# RcppRoll runs on many threads by default when its one-thread control scales (the
# threads table says so); name it that way wherever it is compared
# (the same for an engine that scales on every statistic of the main grid)
eng_scales <- vapply(eng_base, function(e) { r <- thr_eng[thr_eng$entry == e & thr_eng$kind == "main", ]; nrow(r) > 0 && all(r$class == "scales") }, TRUE)
lab_cpu <- function(fn) {
  out <- ifelse(fn == "RcppRoll" & rr_scales, paste0(n_rr_threads, "-thread RcppRoll"), fn)
```
