```{r}
  e <- fn %in% eng_base
  out[e] <- ifelse(eng_scales[fn[e]], paste0(vapply(fn[e], engine_default_threads, 0), "-thread ", fn[e]), fn[e])
  out
}
vs_text <- function(stat, mine = "cuplyr") {
  comp <- setdiff(unique(cells$fn[cells$stat == stat]), excl_cup)
  pats <- vapply(comp, function(e) paste(vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip(stat, mine, w), trip(stat, e, w)), ""), collapse = "|"), "")
  groups <- split(comp, factor(pats, levels = unique(pats)))
  paste(vapply(names(groups), function(p) {
    v <- strsplit(p, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]; v[v == "NA"] <- NA
    sprintf("against %s, %s is %s", join_and(sprintf("%s (%s)", lab_cpu(groups[[p]]), fmt_ms(vapply(groups[[p]], function(e) med(stat, e, w_mid), 0)))), mine, runs_txt(v, widths))
  }, ""), collapse = "; ")
}
mean_vs <- vs_text("mean")
# The ranked entries are the ones at their default settings, the same population as
# the win table; the one-thread controls are not ranked. (Counting them would move
# cuplyr's rank only because controls were added, not because anything got faster.)
rank_of <- function(stat, width, fn = "cuplyr") {
  f <- setdiff(unique(cells$fn[cells$stat == stat]), setdiff(excl_cup, fn))
  v <- vapply(f[!grepl("1 thread", f)], function(e) med(stat, e, width), 0)
  c(rank = unname(rank(v)[fn]), n = length(v))
}
mean_rank <- rank_of("mean", w_mid)
rank_pos <- if (is.na(mean_rank[["rank"]])) "not ranked (its mean at this width was not timed)" else
  if (mean_rank[["rank"]] / mean_rank[["n"]] <= th_front) "near the front" else
  if (mean_rank[["rank"]] / mean_rank[["n"]] >= 1 - th_front) "near the back" else "mid-pack"
rank_detail <- if (is.na(mean_rank[["rank"]])) "" else sprintf(" (rank %s of %s entries at their default settings for mean at w=%s; the one-thread controls are not ranked)", mean_rank[["rank"]], mean_rank[["n"]], w_mid)
sum_v <- vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(trip("sum", "cuplyr", w), trip("sum", "roll", w)), "")
sum_roll_txt <- sprintf("For sum against roll, cuplyr is %s (%s vs %s ms at w=%s).", runs_txt(sum_v), fmt_ms(med("sum", "cuplyr", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med("sum", "roll", w_mid)), w_mid)
mm_win <- widths[vapply(widths, function(w) all(vapply(c("min", "max"), function(s) is_faster(verdict(trip(s, "cuplyr", w), trip(s, "data.table", w))), TRUE)), TRUE)]
mm_w <- if (length(mm_win)) mm_win[1] else w_mid
mm_txt <- sprintf("For min and max it beats data.table %s (cuplyr vs data.table at w=%s: %s)", if (!length(mm_win)) "at no width" else if (length(mm_win) == length(widths)) "at every width" else paste("only at", join_and(paste0("w=", mm_win))),
  mm_w, join_and(vapply(c("min", "max"), function(s) sprintf("%s vs %s ms for %s", fmt_ms(med(s, "cuplyr", mm_w)), fmt_ms(med(s, "data.table", mm_w)), s), "")))
sd_ms <- med_w("sd", "cuplyr")
sd_ranks <- lapply(widths, function(w) rank_of("sd", w))
rank_word <- function(r) if (is.na(r[["rank"]])) "not timed" else if (r[["rank"]] == 1) "fastest" else if (r[["rank"]] == r[["n"]]) "slowest of all" else ordinal(r[["rank"]])
sd_rank_txt <- join_and(mapply(function(r, w) sprintf("%s at w=%s", rank_word(r), w), sd_ranks, widths))
sd_last <- isTRUE(sd_ranks[[3]][["rank"]] == sd_ranks[[3]][["n"]])
sd_others_hi <- setdiff(unique(cells$fn[cells$stat == "sd"]), excl_cup)
sd_others_hi <- sd_others_hi[!grepl("1 thread", sd_others_hi)]
sd_next <- sd_others_hi[which.max(vapply(sd_others_hi, function(e) med("sd", e, w_hi), 0))]
sd_tail <- if (sd_last) sprintf(" (data.table %s; the slowest other entry is %s, %s ms)", fmt_ms(med("sd", "data.table", w_hi)), sd_next, fmt_ms(med("sd", sd_next, w_hi))) else ""
sd_line <- paste0(sd_rank_txt, sd_tail)
sd_sent <- if (all(is.na(sd_ms))) "cuplyr sd was not timed in this run (see the skipped cells)." else
  sprintf("cuplyr sd takes %s ms; among the entries at their default settings it is %s.", slash(sd_ms), sd_line)
fb_txt <- if (median_skipped) sprintf("cuplyr %s is not timed: it has no GPU path and runs on the CPU fallback, so it is left out of every figure here (F3).", code("roll_median()")) else
  if (has_cell("median", "cuplyr", w_mid)) sprintf("cuplyr median takes %s ms (native in this run).", slash(med_w("median", "cuplyr"))) else
  "cuplyr has no median entry in this run."

# ---- how cuplyr scales with the width ------------------------------------------------
trend <- function(stat, fn) { r <- med(stat, fn, w_hi) / med(stat, fn, w_lo); if (is.na(r)) NA_character_ else if (r >= th_trend) "grows" else if (r <= 1 / th_trend) "shrinks" else "flat" }
cup_grow_ratio <- vapply(c("mean", "sd"), function(s) med(s, "cuplyr", w_hi) / med(s, "cuplyr", w_lo), 0)
# unknown when a cuplyr mean or sd cell at the narrowest or widest width was not timed
cup_grow_known <- !anyNA(cup_grow_ratio)
cup_grows <- cup_grow_known && all(cup_grow_ratio >= th_trend)
grow_unknown_why <- sprintf("a cuplyr mean or sd cell at w=%s or w=%s was not timed", w_lo, w_hi)
# "1.99 / 2.05 / 4.10 ms", with "not timed" for a missing cell
fig_w <- function(v) if (all(is.na(v))) "not timed" else paste(paste(ifelse(is.na(v), "not timed", fmt_ms(v)), collapse = " / "), "ms")
grow_figs <- sprintf("mean %s; sd %s", fig_w(med_w("mean", "cuplyr")), fig_w(sd_ms))
trend_fns <- c("data.table", "data.table (exact)", "roll", "RcppRoll")
trend_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(trend_fns, function(f) data.frame(fn = f, stat = fn_stats(f)[fn_stats(f) %in% stat_order], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
trend_df$trend <- mapply(trend, trend_df$stat, trend_df$fn)
trend_items <- function(kind) {
  d <- trend_df[trend_df$trend %in% kind, ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(character())
  unlist(lapply(unique(d$fn), function(f) {
    s <- d$stat[d$fn == f]
    all_s <- fn_stats(f)[fn_stats(f) %in% stat_order]
    if (f == "data.table (exact)") "data.table's exact sum"
    else if (length(s) == length(all_s) && length(s) > 1) lab_cpu(f) else sprintf("%s's %s", lab_cpu(f), paste(s, collapse = "/"))
  }))
}
trend_flat <- join_and(trend_items("flat")); trend_down <- join_and(trend_items("shrinks")); trend_up <- join_and(trend_items("grows"))
width_ratio <- w_hi / w_mid
sd_up <- med("sd", "cuplyr", w_hi) / med("sd", "cuplyr", w_mid)
grow_txt <- if (!cup_grow_known) sprintf("Whether cuplyr's cost grows with the window width is not known from this run (%s; %s)", grow_unknown_why, grow_figs) else
  if (cup_grows) sprintf("cuplyr's cost grows with the window width (%s)", grow_figs) else
  sprintf("cuplyr's cost does not grow strongly with the window width (%s)", grow_figs)
trend_txt <- sprintf("%s are flat in the width%s%s",
  trend_flat, if (nzchar(trend_down)) sprintf(" (%s get faster with the width", trend_down) else "",
  if (nzchar(trend_up)) sprintf("%s %s get slower)", if (nzchar(trend_down)) ";" else " (", trend_up) else if (nzchar(trend_down)) ")" else "")
incr_txt <- if (cup_grows) "\"The kernel is not incremental\" is my inference from that scaling; I did not read or profile the kernel (F2)." else "I did not read or profile the kernel (F2)."
rescan_txt <- if (!cup_grow_known) "" else if (cup_grows) {
  if (is.na(sd_up)) "That pattern is what a kernel that rescans each window would produce." else
    sprintf("That pattern is what a kernel that rescans each window would produce (sd goes up %s for a %s wider window).", fmt_x(sd_up), fmt_x(width_ratio, 0))
} else "That is not the pattern a kernel that rescans each window would produce."

# ---- grouped and large ------------------------------------------------------------------
g_cup <- ext_med(grp_lab, "cuplyr", group_width); g_dt <- ext_med(grp_lab, "data.table (by = g)", group_width)
g_sl <- ext_med(grp_lab, "slider (grouped_df)", group_width); g_dt1 <- ext_med(grp_lab, "data.table (by = g, 1 thread)", group_width)
g_dir <- function(r) if (is.na(r)) "not comparable with" else if (r >= 1 + th_level) sprintf("about %s faster than", fmt_xr(r)) else if (r <= 1 / (1 + th_level)) sprintf("about %s slower than", fmt_xr(1 / r)) else "level with"
g_pl <- ext_med(grp_lab, "polars", group_width); g_dd <- ext_med(grp_lab, "DuckDB", group_width)
g_pl1 <- ext_med(grp_lab, "polars (1 thread)", group_width); g_dd1 <- ext_med(grp_lab, "DuckDB (1 thread)", group_width)
g_txt <- if (is.na(g_cup)) sprintf("cuplyr was not timed (%s), so there is no grouped comparison; data.table by group took %s ms, slider %s ms, polars %s ms and DuckDB %s ms",
                                   if (any(sk$chunk == "bench-ext" & sk$stat == "grouped mean")) "its probe call fell back to the CPU" else "its cell failed",
                                   fmt_ms(g_dt), fmt_ms(g_sl), fmt_ms(g_pl), fmt_ms(g_dd)) else
  sprintf("cuplyr %s ms vs data.table by group %s ms, slider %s ms, polars %s ms and DuckDB %s ms, so cuplyr is %s data.table, %s slider, %s polars and %s DuckDB, computation only",
          fmt_ms(g_cup), fmt_ms(g_dt), fmt_ms(g_sl), fmt_ms(g_pl), fmt_ms(g_dd),
          g_dir(g_dt / g_cup), g_dir(g_sl / g_cup), g_dir(g_pl / g_cup), g_dir(g_dd / g_cup))
# the fastest entry means against every other entry of the experiment (the one-thread controls included)
g_others <- ext$median_ms[ext$experiment == grp_lab & ext$fn != "cuplyr"]
g_fast <- isTRUE(g_cup < min(g_others, na.rm = TRUE))
by_verb <- if (by_flat) "ran effectively single-threaded" else "used threads"
by_tail <- if (by_flat && !is.na(g_cup)) sprintf(", so the %s is the GPU against **one CPU thread making %s per-group calls**, not against %s threads", fmt_xr(g_dt / g_cup), fmt_int(n_groups), n_dt_threads) else ""
ung_fns <- unique(ext$fn[ext$experiment == "ungrouped mean"])
thr_label <- function(fn) {
  base <- fn
  r <- thr_both[thr_both$kind == "ungrouped" & thr_both$entry == base, ]
  if (nrow(r) && r$class[1] == "scales") paste0(sub(" .*", "", r$threads[1]), "-thread ", base) else base
}
ung_at <- function(w) {
  others <- setdiff(ung_fns, "cuplyr")
  data.frame(fn = others, med = vapply(others, function(e) ext_med("ungrouped mean", e, w), 0),
             v = vapply(others, function(e) verdict(ext_trip("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", w), ext_trip("ungrouped mean", e, w)), ""),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
# widths with a cuplyr figure (a skipped or failed cell has none)
ung_have <- vapply(widths, function(w) !is.na(ext_med("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", w)), TRUE)
ung_fast <- ung_have & vapply(widths, function(w) { d <- ung_at(w); all(is_faster(d$v)) }, TRUE)
ung_txt <- function(w) {
  d <- ung_at(w)
  cup <- ext_med("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", w)
  scaled <- d$fn[grepl("1 thread", d$fn)]
  scaled <- scaled[vapply(scaled, function(e) { b <- rw_base_label(e); r <- thr_both[thr_both$kind == "ungrouped" & thr_both$entry == b, ]; nrow(r) > 0 && r$class[1] == "scales" }, TRUE)]
  dflt <- d[!grepl("1 thread", d$fn), ]
  if (all(is_faster(d$v))) {
    sprintf("%s ms vs %s%s", fmt_ms(cup), join_and(sprintf("%s %s", vapply(dflt$fn, thr_label, ""), fmt_ms(dflt$med))),
            if (length(scaled)) paste0("; ", join_and(sprintf("one-thread %s %s", vapply(scaled, rw_base_label, ""), fmt_ms(d$med[match(scaled, d$fn)])))) else "")
  } else {
    ahead <- dflt[is_slower(dflt$v), ]; lvl <- dflt[dflt$v == "level" | grepl("slightly", dflt$v), ]
    sprintf("%s ms vs %s%s", fmt_ms(cup), join_and(sprintf("%s %s", vapply(ahead$fn, thr_label, ""), fmt_ms(ahead$med))),
            if (nrow(lvl)) sprintf("; level with %s", join_and(sprintf("%s %s", lvl$fn, fmt_ms(lvl$med)))) else "")
  }
}
ung_fast_txt <- join_and(vapply(widths[ung_fast], function(w) sprintf("w=%s (%s)", w, ung_txt(w)), ""))
ung_slow_txt <- join_and(vapply(widths[ung_have & !ung_fast], function(w) sprintf("w=%s (%s)", w, ung_txt(w)), ""))
ung_beats_rr <- any(vapply(widths[ung_fast], function(w) { d <- ung_at(w); "RcppRoll" %in% d$fn && is_faster(d$v[d$fn == "RcppRoll"]) }, TRUE))
ung_sent <- paste0(
  sprintf("At %s ungrouped rows (one size) cuplyr is ", ext_txt),
  if (any(ung_fast)) sprintf("fastest at %s", ung_fast_txt) else "not the fastest at any width",
  if (any(ung_have & !ung_fast)) sprintf("%s %s", if (any(ung_fast)) ", and loses at" else ":", ung_slow_txt) else "",
  if (any(!ung_have)) sprintf("; it was not timed at %s", join_and(paste0("w=", widths[!ung_have]))) else "", ".")
peak_bytes <- suppressWarnings(max(ext$peak_gpu_bytes, na.rm = TRUE))
peak_txt <- if (!is.finite(peak_bytes)) sprintf("No %s-row cuplyr call was measured for peak GPU memory", ext_txt) else
  sprintf("Peak GPU memory for the %s-row call was %s, %s inside %s GB", ext_txt, fmt_mb(peak_bytes),
          if (peak_bytes < th_mem * gpu_gb * 1e9) "well" else "not far", gpu_gb)

ung_loss <- ung_have & vapply(widths, function(w) { d <- ung_at(w); d <- d[!grepl("1 thread", d$fn), ]; any(is_slower(d$v)) }, TRUE)
net_fast <- c(if (g_fast) sprintf("the grouped configuration (%s groups)", groups_txt),
              if (any(ung_fast)) sprintf("%s rows with windows of %s", ext_txt, join_and(widths[ung_fast])))
net_slow <- c(if (!g_fast && !is.na(g_cup)) "the grouped configuration",
              if (any(ung_have & !ung_fast)) sprintf("%s rows with windows of %s", ext_txt, join_and(widths[ung_have & !ung_fast])))
# the scope of the large-configuration wins: narrow windows only when every width it
# won is narrower than every width it did not (among the widths it was timed at)
ung_not_fast <- widths[ung_have & !ung_fast]
net_scope <- if (any(ung_fast) && length(ung_not_fast) && max(widths[ung_fast]) < min(ung_not_fast)) "narrow windows" else "the widths where it was fastest"
net_lose <- if (any(ung_loss)) sprintf(", and it loses at %s", join_and(paste0("w=", widths[ung_loss]))) else
  if (length(net_slow)) sprintf(", and it is not clearly ahead for %s", join_and(net_slow)) else ""
net_txt <- paste0(
  if (length(net_fast)) sprintf("In the larger configurations measured it was the fastest entry for %s%s", join_and(net_fast),
                                if (ung_beats_rr) sprintf(", including against %s at %s rows", lab_cpu("RcppRoll"), ext_txt) else "") else "In the larger configurations measured it was not the fastest entry anywhere",
  "; that is one grouped configuration, one large size", if (any(ung_fast)) paste(" and", net_scope) else "", net_lose, ". All of it only when the data already lives on the GPU.")

# ---- per-call overhead ----------------------------------------------------------------------
call_labels <- names(rw_overhead_calls(w_mid))
lab_plain <- call_labels[1]; lab_roll <- call_labels[2]; lab_cum <- call_labels[3]
oh_med <- function(label, rows) stats::median(oh$ms[oh$stat == "overhead" & oh$fn == label & oh$n_rows == rows])
floor_df <- oh[oh$stat != "overhead" & oh$n_rows == small_rows, ]
floor_by_stat <- tapply(floor_df$ms, floor_df$stat, stats::median)
floor_ms <- stats::median(floor_by_stat)
plain_small <- oh_med(lab_plain, small_rows); roll_small <- oh_med(lab_roll, small_rows); cum_small <- oh_med(lab_cum, small_rows)
plain_big <- oh_med(lab_plain, n_rows); roll_big <- oh_med(lab_roll, n_rows); cum_big <- oh_med(lab_cum, n_rows)
win_extra <- floor_ms - plain_small
cum_same <- isTRUE(abs(cum_small / roll_small - 1) < th_same)
kernel_txt <- if (cum_same) "not any single kernel" else "which may include part of the kernel's cost"
cum_vs_roll_txt <- if (anyNA(c(cum_small, roll_small))) "cumsum and roll_mean are not both timed here, so the extra cost is not split between the path and the kernel." else
  if (cum_same) sprintf("cumsum costs the same as roll_mean, so the extra %s ms (%s of the floor) belongs to the window-function path, not to any one kernel.", fmt_1(win_extra), fmt_pct(win_extra / floor_ms, 0)) else
  sprintf("cumsum and roll_mean differ here (%s vs %s ms), so part of the extra %s ms may belong to the kernel rather than to the window-function path.", fmt_ms(cum_small), fmt_ms(roll_small), fmt_1(win_extra))
floor_vs_dt <- { r <- floor_ms / med("mean", "data.table", w_mid); if (is.na(r)) "not comparable with" else if (r >= 1 + th_level) "larger than" else if (r <= 1 / (1 + th_level)) "smaller than" else "about the same as" }
floor_share <- floor_ms / med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo)
floor_share_txt <- if (is.na(floor_share)) sprintf("not set against the cuplyr mean at width %s here (not timed in this run)", w_lo) else
  sprintf("about %s of the %s ms measured at %s rows / width %s", fmt_pct(floor_share, 0), fmt_ms(med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo)), rows_txt, w_lo)
f4_share_txt <- if (is.na(floor_share)) "" else sprintf(", and the floor is about %s of the narrow-window rolling cost", fmt_pct(floor_share, 0))
n_floor_samples <- nrow(floor_df)

plan_nodes <- lapply(bench_overhead$plans, function(l) { x <- regmatches(l, regexpr("ast_[a-z_]+", l)); x })
plan_plain <- plan_nodes[[lab_plain]]; plan_win <- plan_nodes[[lab_roll]]
n_mat_plain <- sum(plan_plain != "ast_source"); n_mat_win <- sum(plan_win != "ast_source")
chain_win <- paste(plan_win, collapse = " <- "); chain_plain <- paste(plan_plain, collapse = " <- ")
# "a window node, a mutate node and a select node", from the captured plan
node_list <- join_and(paste("a", sub("^ast_", "", rev(plan_win[plan_win != "ast_source"])), "node"))

# memory: the decomposition of the bytes held after one eager window mutate
# a memory call that was skipped (CPU fallback) leaves NA figures, not an error
mem_na <- function(lab) data.frame(call = lab, n_rows = ext_rows, x_column_bytes = 8 * ext_rows, allocated_bytes = NA_real_,
                                   held_after_call_bytes = NA_real_, peak_bytes = NA_real_, held_after_gc_bytes = NA_real_)
mb <- mem_breakdown
mem_get <- function(lab) if (!is.null(mb) && any(mb$call == lab)) mb[mb$call == lab, ][1, ] else mem_na(lab)
mb_roll <- mem_get(lab_roll); mb_plain <- mem_get(lab_plain); mb_cum <- mem_get(lab_cum)
n_mem <- mb_roll$n_rows
mask_bytes <- function(n) ceiling(n / 512) * 64
col_b <- mb_roll$x_column_bytes
bytes_per_row <- col_b / n_mem
win_out <- 2 * col_b + mask_bytes(n_mem); mut_out <- 3 * col_b + 2 * mask_bytes(n_mem); sel_out <- 2 * col_b + mask_bytes(n_mem)
pred_held <- win_out + mut_out + sel_out
held_roll <- mb_roll$held_after_call_bytes; result_roll <- mb_roll$held_after_gc_bytes
held_ratio <- held_roll / result_roll
mem_measured <- !is.na(held_roll) && !is.na(result_roll)
# What F57 changed, as the bytes show it. The result's own new column is r (8 bytes a
# row) with its validity mask; a result of less than two columns holds no copy of x
# (x is shared with the input table). F1 is resolved when what is held right after
# the call is the result alone (within th_same): nothing else awaits finalization.
new_col_bytes <- col_b + mask_bytes(n_mem)
x_shared <- mem_measured && result_roll < 2 * col_b
f1_resolved <- mem_measured && abs(held_ratio - 1) < th_same
alloc_ratio <- mb_roll$allocated_bytes / result_roll
mem_lead <- if (!mem_measured) "GPU memory of the rolling call was not measured" else
  if (f1_resolved && x_shared) "GPU memory agrees: right after the call only the result is held, and it holds no copy of x" else
  if (f1_resolved) "GPU memory shows only the result held right after the call, but the result holds a copy of x" else
  "GPU memory shows more than the result held right after the call"
mem_txt <- if (!mem_measured) "The rolling call was not measured for memory in this run, so the sharing is not checked here." else paste0(
  sprintf("Right after a %s mutate %s B are held, and after a %s the result alone holds %s B: %s. ",
          code("roll_mean"), fmt_int(held_roll), code("gc()"), fmt_int(result_roll),
          if (f1_resolved) sprintf("what is held right after the call is the result (held / result %s), and nothing else awaits finalization", fmt_x(held_ratio)) else
            sprintf("%s the result is held right after the call, so intermediates still await finalization", fmt_x(held_ratio))),
  if (isTRUE(result_roll == new_col_bytes)) sprintf("The result is exactly one %s-byte column of %s rows plus its validity mask (%s + %s B), the size of the new column %s: %s is shared with the input table, not copied. ",
                                                    bytes_per_row, ext_txt, fmt_int(col_b), fmt_int(mask_bytes(n_mem)), code("r"), code("x")) else
    if (x_shared) sprintf("The result holds less than two %s-byte columns of %s rows (%s B each), so it holds no copy of %s. ", bytes_per_row, ext_txt, fmt_int(col_b), code("x")) else
    sprintf("The result holds at least two columns of %s B, so it may hold a copy of %s. ", fmt_int(col_b), code("x")),
  sprintf("Before F57 the node chain built %s tables, one per node: %s (window output: x + %s + validity mask) + %s (mutate output: x + %s + %s + two masks) + %s (select output, the result) = %s B, reasoned from the node chain and sized from the column bytes and the padded validity mask, not measured here; the %s B measured now are %s of that sum. ",
          words(n_mat_win), fmt_int(win_out), code("..win1.."), fmt_int(mut_out), code("..win1.."), code("r"), fmt_int(sel_out), fmt_int(pred_held),
          fmt_int(held_roll), fmt_pct(held_roll / pred_held, 0)),
  if (is.na(mb_plain$held_after_call_bytes)) "" else
    sprintf("A plain mutate holds %s B right after the call%s and allocates %s B in total. ", fmt_int(mb_plain$held_after_call_bytes),
            if (mb_plain$held_after_call_bytes == col_b) sprintf(" (exactly one %s-byte column of %s rows, the size of the new column %s alone)", bytes_per_row, ext_txt, code("y")) else "",
            fmt_int(mb_plain$allocated_bytes)),
  if (isTRUE(mb_roll$allocated_bytes > held_roll)) sprintf("One %s mutate allocates %s B in total while it runs (%s its result; peak %s B) and frees all of it but the result before it returns; I did not break that transient allocation down.",
                                                        code("roll_mean"), fmt_int(mb_roll$allocated_bytes), fmt_x(alloc_ratio, 0), fmt_int(mb_roll$peak_bytes)) else "")
# the allocation side of the per-call cost: a copy of x only when the bytes show one
alloc_part <- if (x_shared) "allocation" else "copy and allocation"

# the narrow-window rolling mean against the cumsum mutate, at the post's size;
# either cell can be missing (not timed), and then nothing is compared
w_lo_vs_cum <- med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo) - cum_big
narrow_chain <- w_lo_vs_cum / med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo) < th_chain
narrow_txt <- if (is.na(narrow_chain)) {
  sprintf("not compared with the %s mutate here, because %s was not timed", code("cumsum"),
          if (is.na(med("mean", "cuplyr", w_lo))) "the narrow-window rolling mean" else "the cumsum mutate")
} else paste0(
  if (w_lo_vs_cum >= 0) sprintf("only %s ms above", fmt_ms(w_lo_vs_cum)) else sprintf("%s ms below", fmt_ms(-w_lo_vs_cum)),
  " the ", code("cumsum"), " mutate: ",
  if (narrow_chain) sprintf("at narrow widths, most of cuplyr's time at this size is the call chain and the %s, not the rolling kernel", if (x_shared) "allocations" else "copies") else
    "at narrow widths the rolling kernel is a visible part of cuplyr's time at this size")

# Read this first: what the window chain costs per call, as the code and the bytes show it
chain_share_txt <- if (x_shared) sprintf("which run as one chain that shares the input column %s instead of copying it, so only the computed columns and their validity masks are allocated", code("x")) else
  if (mem_measured) sprintf("which run as one chain, although the bytes held after a call show a copy of %s in the result, and the allocation of the results and their validity masks", code("x")) else
  sprintf("which run as one chain that is meant to share the input column %s (the memory of the call was not measured in this run), and the allocation of the results and their validity masks", code("x"))

# F1, from the same bytes
f1_head <- if (!mem_measured) "addressed by F57; not measured in this run" else if (f1_resolved && x_shared) "resolved by F57" else "addressed by F57, not resolved in this run"
f1_meas_txt <- if (!mem_measured) "The memory of the call was not measured in this run, so whether the fix holds is not checked here." else paste0(
  sprintf("In this run, right after the call %s B are held (%s), and after a %s the result alone holds %s B (held / result %s; %s, %s). ",
          fmt_int(held_roll), code("gpu_alloc_tracking()"), code("gc()"), fmt_int(result_roll), fmt_x(held_ratio), code("memory-breakdown.csv"), code("memory-finding.csv")),
  if (f1_resolved && x_shared) sprintf("No intermediate table outlives the call and the result holds no copy of %s, so F1 is resolved: the remaining per-call cost has no materialization component (no table is copied and nothing beyond the result is held).", code("x")) else
    if (f1_resolved) sprintf("Nothing beyond the result is held, but the result holds a copy of %s, so F1 is only partly resolved.", code("x")) else
    sprintf("Right after the call %s the result is held, so intermediates still await finalization and F1 is not resolved in this run.", fmt_x(held_ratio)),
  if (isTRUE(mb_roll$allocated_bytes > held_roll)) sprintf(" While it runs, the call still allocates %s B in total (peak %s B) and frees all of it but the result before it returns (see \"Per-call cost breakdown\").",
                                                        fmt_int(mb_roll$allocated_bytes), fmt_int(mb_roll$peak_bytes)) else "")
f1_tail <- if (f1_resolved && x_shared) "" else
  " Freeing per-call intermediates deterministically (or an automatic `gpu_gc()` and retry on `bad_alloc`) would remain a separate hardening."

# the no-gc() finding
failed_at <- mem_finding$failed_at_call; n_calls <- mem_finding$n_calls
oom_quote <- sub("^(GPU operation '[^']*' failed).*(std::bad_alloc: out_of_memory: CUDA).*$", "\\1 ... \\2", gsub("\\s+", " ", mem_finding$error))
oom_quote <- if (!is.na(failed_at) && grepl("out_of_memory", mem_finding$error)) oom_quote else NA_character_
gc_lead <- if (!is.na(failed_at)) paste("cuplyr needs the", code("gc()")) else paste("cuplyr is given the", code("gc()"), "too")
# what waits for R's GC: since F57 the dropped results only (F1 resolved), else intermediates too
gc_wait <- if (f1_resolved) "the dropped results" else "the intermediates"
gc_why_txt <- if (f1_resolved) sprintf("the result of an eager %s, once dropped, is freed only when R finalizes its pointer", code("mutate()")) else
  sprintf("an eager %s holds its GPU intermediates until R finalizes their pointers", code("mutate()"))
gc_need_txt <- if (!is.na(failed_at)) sprintf("%s back-to-back %s-row calls without it ran the %s GB card out of memory", words(n_calls), ext_txt, gpu_gb) else
  sprintf("%s back-to-back %s-row calls without it did not run the %s GB card out of memory in this run, but %s still pile up until a collection", words(n_calls), ext_txt, gpu_gb, gc_wait)
f1_oom_lead <- if (f1_resolved) "A dropped result is still freed only when R finalizes its pointer" else "The intermediates are freed only when R finalizes their pointers"
f1_oom_txt <- if (!is.na(failed_at)) sprintf("%s back-to-back calls without %s ran out of memory at the %s (%s) on the %s GB card, with the results dropped each time",
                                             words(n_calls), code("gc()"), ordinal(failed_at), if (is.na(oom_quote)) "no error text" else paste0("\"", oom_quote, "\""), gpu_gb) else
  sprintf("%s back-to-back calls without %s did not run out of memory at this size on the %s GB card", words(n_calls), code("gc()"), gpu_gb)
# where cuplyr's dropped tables go in that gc(): the memory resource cuplyr runs on
# (read at render time; the timings ran under the same package defaults)
mr_kind <- tryCatch(cuplyr:::gpu_memory_state()$resource, error = function(e) NA_character_)
mr_release <- tryCatch(cuplyr:::memory_resource_release_threshold(), error = function(e) NA_real_)
free_txt <- switch(if (is.na(mr_kind)) "unknown" else mr_kind,
  async = paste0(sprintf("cuplyr's GPU tables go back to CUDA's asynchronous memory pool, cuplyr's default memory resource, with %s inside that untimed %s", code("cudaFreeAsync"), code("gc()")),
                 if (is.na(mr_release)) ", and the pool keeps the memory for reuse (no release threshold is set)" else
                   sprintf(", although with the release threshold set here (%s B) CUDA may return memory to the device at the next synchronisation, which is the fence inside the timed call", fmt_int(mr_release))),
  pool = sprintf("cuplyr's GPU tables go back to RMM's pool inside that untimed %s", code("gc()")),
  cuda = sprintf("cuplyr's GPU tables are freed with %s inside that untimed %s", code("cudaFree"), code("gc()")),
  sprintf("cuplyr's GPU tables are freed inside that untimed %s", code("gc()")))

# the per-call floor against the native calls at the post's size, per width: a floor
# measured in another chunk on a small table is not a strict lower bound, and where
# it exceeds a whole call the text says so instead of calling it a part of it
nat_w <- lapply(widths, function(w) { v <- vapply(cup_native, function(s) med(s, "cuplyr", w), 0); v[!is.na(v)] })
floor_over_all <- widths[vapply(nat_w, function(v) length(v) > 0 && floor_ms > max(v), TRUE)]
floor_over_some <- widths[vapply(nat_w, function(v) length(v) > 0 && floor_ms > min(v) && floor_ms <= max(v), TRUE)]
nat_all <- unlist(nat_w)
nat_floor_txt <- paste0(sprintf("against a per-call floor of about %s ms for window mutates (on a %s-row table)", fmt_1(floor_ms), small_txt),
  if (length(floor_over_all) || length(floor_over_some)) paste0(", which ", join_and(c(
      if (length(floor_over_all)) sprintf("exceeds the whole call at %s", join_and(paste0("w=", floor_over_all))),
      if (length(floor_over_some)) sprintf("exceeds some of the calls at %s", join_and(paste0("w=", floor_over_some))))),
    " (the floor was timed in another chunk, so it is not a strict lower bound)") else
  if (length(nat_all)) sprintf(", which is %s of these calls", { p <- fmt_pct(range(floor_ms / nat_all), 0); if (p[1] == p[2]) p[1] else paste0(p[1], "-", p[2]) }) else "")
# the same for Net: how much of cuplyr's mean call the floor is
floor_share_mid <- floor_ms / med("mean", "cuplyr", w_mid)
floor_shares <- c(floor_share, floor_share_mid)
net_floor_txt <- if (all(is.na(floor_shares))) sprintf("its per-call floor is about %s ms", fmt_1(floor_ms)) else
  sprintf("per-call cost is %s its time there (the %s-row floor of about %s ms is %s)",
          if (min(floor_shares, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0.5) "most of" else "a part of", small_txt, fmt_1(floor_ms),
          join_and(c(if (!is.na(floor_share)) sprintf("%s of its mean call at w=%s", fmt_pct(floor_share, 0), w_lo),
                     if (!is.na(floor_share_mid)) sprintf("%s at w=%s", fmt_pct(floor_share_mid, 0), w_mid))))
# the peak of the large call, in the Conclusions: transient once F1 is resolved
peak_f1_txt <- if (f1_resolved && x_shared && is.finite(peak_bytes)) sprintf(", and transient: right after the call only the %s result is held (F1)", fmt_mb(result_roll)) else ", but see F1"
# F4's candidate row: with F1 resolved there is no materialization left to remove
f4_chain_txt <- sprintf("%s nodes, run as one execution", words(n_mat_win))
f4_row_txt <- if (f1_resolved && x_shared) sprintf("Since F57 this cost has no materialization component: no table is copied and nothing beyond the result is held (F1). Candidate row: profile the window path's extra %s ms (the %s node builds and schema inferences in R, the lowering, the kernel launches) and the %s ms every eager mutate pays (R dispatch, AST build, schema inference), since I did not.",
                                             fmt_1(win_extra), words(n_mat_win), fmt_1(plain_small)) else
  sprintf("Candidate row (same as F1): remove the remaining materializations, then re-measure the %s-row floor; profile the remaining %s ms plain-mutate cost (R dispatch, AST build, schema inference) separately, since I did not.", small_txt, fmt_1(plain_small))

# ---- Deviations -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# What the fence costs: the on and off calls were timed in alternation, so the
# difference is a paired one.
fence_df <- bench_fence$timings
have_fence <- !is.null(fence_df)
th_fence <- 1
if (have_fence) {
  f_on <- fence_df[fence_df$label == "on", ]; f_off <- fence_df[fence_df$label == "off", ]
  fence_on <- stats::median(f_on$ms); fence_off <- stats::median(f_off$ms)
  fence_diff <- stats::median(f_on$ms - f_off$ms[match(f_on$sample, f_off$sample)])
  fence_n <- nrow(f_on)
}
fence_txt <- if (have_fence) sprintf("the rolling mean at %s rows, w=%s, in %s ms with the fence and %s ms without, %s interleaved pairs, median paired difference %s ms",
                                      ext_txt, w_mid, fmt_ms(fence_on), fmt_ms(fence_off), fence_n, fmt_ms(fence_diff)) else
  "nothing: the cell was skipped (see the skipped cells)"
fence_cost <- if (!have_fence) "an unmeasured amount" else if (abs(fence_diff) < th_fence) sprintf("under %s ms", th_fence) else sprintf("about %s ms", fmt_ms(abs(fence_diff)))
probe_sample_cells <- sum(grepl("^one sample, and it is the cold first call", cells$note))
probe_txt <- if (probe_sample_cells == 0) "which no cell did" else sprintf("which %s %s did", words(probe_sample_cells), plural(probe_sample_cells, "cell"))
warmup_txt <- sprintf("%s; %s above %s s; %s above %s s", rw_warmup_tiers$warmup[1], rw_warmup_tiers$warmup[2], rw_warmup_tiers$above_s[2], rw_warmup_tiers$warmup[3], rw_warmup_tiers$above_s[3])

# runstats: the figures the results tables show, and the paired effect of the
# alignment shift from the side chunk (its own, interleaved samples)
rs <- bench_runstats$timings
have_rs <- !is.null(rs)
rs_main <- c(mean = med("mean", "runstats", w_mid), sd = med("sd", "runstats", w_mid))
rs_side <- function(stat, shift) stats::median(rs$ms[rs$stat == stat & rs$shift == shift])
rs_pair <- function(stat) {
  o <- rs[rs$stat == stat & rs$shift == "outside", ]; i <- rs[rs$stat == stat & rs$shift == "inside", ]
  stats::median(i$ms[match(o$sample, i$sample)] - o$ms)
}
rs_within <- function(a, b) a / b <= th_x && a / b >= 1 / th_x
rs_txt <- if (have_rs) sprintf("Chunk %s timed the same two calls again with the shift inside the call, interleaved with the unshifted calls (%s pairs per statistic; these are that chunk's own samples, not the tables'). In those pairs the shift adds %s ms to the mean call (%s ms unshifted, %s ms shifted) and %s ms to the sd call (%s and %s ms), so the shift %s.",
  code("bench-runstats-shift"), length(unique(rs$sample[rs$stat == "mean"])), fmt_ms(rs_pair("mean")), fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "outside")), fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "inside")),
  fmt_ms(rs_pair("sd")), fmt_ms(rs_side("sd", "outside")), fmt_ms(rs_side("sd", "inside")),
  if (rs_pair("mean") > th_part * rs_side("mean", "outside")) "is a sizeable part of the mean figure" else "is a small part of the mean figure") else
  "runstats is not installed, so the effect of the shift was not measured."
rs_agree_txt <- if (!have_rs) "" else if (rs_within(rs_side("mean", "outside"), rs_main[["mean"]]) && rs_within(rs_side("sd", "outside"), rs_main[["sd"]]))
  "The unshifted figures of that chunk agree with the tables'." else
  sprintf("The unshifted figures of that chunk (%s and %s ms) are not the tables' (%s and %s ms): the same call took different times in two chunks of this render, which this report does not explain. The tables' figures are the ones reported; from the side chunk only the paired difference is used.",
          fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "outside")), fmt_ms(rs_side("sd", "outside")), fmt_ms(rs_main[["mean"]]), fmt_ms(rs_main[["sd"]]))

# core placement: what pinning shows, which calls run on one thread, and the
# cross-check of the one-thread RcppRoll cells. The paragraph itself is in the
# "Hardware and versions" section; these are its data-dependent pieces.
core <- bench_cores$timings
core_ok <- !is.null(core) && all(c("fast", "slow") %in% core$kind)
# one row per pinned CPU (in the order they were pinned): its median
core_cpu <- if (core_ok) do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(core$cpu), function(cp) {
  d <- core[core$cpu == cp, ]
  data.frame(kind = d$kind[1], cpu = cp, apart = d$apart[1], med = stats::median(d$ms), n = nrow(d), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})) else NULL
# The sanity check: the two CPUs of one kind must agree within th_x, else the
# measurement was disturbed (one CPU busy, or a transient disturbance) and no
# figure from it is quoted. NA for a kind with one CPU (nothing to check against).
core_spread <- vapply(c(fast = "fast", slow = "slow"), function(k) {
  m <- core_cpu$med[core_cpu$kind == k]
  if (length(m) < 2L) NA_real_ else max(m) / min(m)
}, 0)
core_disturbed <- names(core_spread)[!is.na(core_spread) & core_spread > th_x]
core_clean <- core_ok && !length(core_disturbed)
# the median of all samples of one kind, only from a clean measurement
core_med <- function(k) if (core_clean) stats::median(core$ms[core$kind == k]) else NA_real_
core_row <- function(k) if (core_ok) core[core$kind == k, ][1, ] else list(n_cpus = NA, kind_mhz = NA)
core_fast <- core_row("fast"); core_slow <- core_row("slow")
core_ratio <- core_med("slow") / core_med("fast")
core_matters <- isTRUE(core_ratio >= th_core)
apart_words <- c(L2 = "with separate L2 caches", core = "on different cores", cpu = "on one core")
core_pins_txt <- if (!core_ok) "" else paste(vapply(c("fast", "slow"), function(k) {
  d <- core_cpu[core_cpu$kind == k, ]
  if (nrow(d) == 1L) sprintf("%s CPU %s (the only one of its kind)", k, d$cpu) else
    sprintf("%s CPUs %s (%s)", k, join_and(d$cpu), apart_words[[d$apart[1]]])
}, ""), collapse = " and ")
core_n_samples <- if (core_ok) max(core_cpu$n) else NA
# the per-CPU medians, only from a clean measurement (a disturbed one is not
# quoted; its samples are still in cores.csv)
core_figs_txt <- if (!core_clean) "" else paste0(": ", paste(vapply(c("fast", "slow"), function(k) {
  d <- core_cpu[core_cpu$kind == k, ]
  sprintf("%s ms on %s CPU%s %s", join_and(fmt_ms(d$med)), k, if (nrow(d) > 1L) "s" else "", join_and(d$cpu))
}, ""), collapse = " and "), " (medians)")
core_unchecked <- names(core_spread)[is.na(core_spread)]
core_effect_txt <- if (!core_ok) "" else if (!core_clean) {
  sprintf("%s (%s, more than a factor of %s), so this measurement was disturbed and is not quoted: no figure from it and no fast/slow ratio is used anywhere in this report, and how much landing on a slow core costs a single-threaded call is not known from this render.",
          if (length(core_disturbed) == 2L) "The two CPUs of each kind disagree" else sprintf("The two %s CPUs disagree", core_disturbed),
          join_and(sprintf("%s%s apart", if (length(core_disturbed) == 2L) paste0(core_disturbed, " ") else "", fmt_x(core_spread[core_disturbed], 2))), th_x)
} else {
  paste0(if (length(core_unchecked) == 2L) "Each kind has only one CPU, so the figures are not checked against a second CPU" else
           if (length(core_unchecked)) sprintf("The two %s CPUs agree within a factor of %s (the %s kind has one CPU, so it is not checked against a second)", setdiff(c("fast", "slow"), core_unchecked), th_x, core_unchecked) else
           sprintf("The two CPUs of each kind agree within a factor of %s", th_x),
         ", so the measurement is quoted: ",
         if (core_matters) sprintf("over all the samples of each kind, landing on a slow core costs this single-threaded call %s.", fmt_x(core_ratio)) else
           "over all the samples of each kind, core placement does not matter measurably for that call.",
         # what the check cannot see (N18): it compares two CPUs of one kind only
         if (length(core_unchecked) < 2L) " The check compares the two CPUs of a kind with each other, so it cannot detect load that slows both of them alike; the machine's load during the chunk was not recorded, so such load is not ruled out." else "")
}

# The calls of the threads table at w=101, named per call: data.table by
# function (frollmean/sum/..., frollapply), any other entry by package, or by
# statistic when only some of its calls are in the group.
# The threads table has the post's packages and the engines (thr_both): the lists
# below name every call of it, polars and DuckDB included.
thr_main <- thr_both[thr_both$kind == "main", ]
calls_other <- function(rows) {
  e_all <- unique(rows$entry[!grepl("^data\\.table", rows$entry)])
  vapply(e_all, function(e) {
    s <- rows$statistic[rows$entry == e]
    if (setequal(s, thr_main$statistic[thr_main$entry == e])) e else sprintf("%s's %s", e, paste(s, collapse = "/"))
  }, "")
}
calls_dt <- function(rows) {
  d <- rows[grepl("^data\\.table", rows$entry), ]
  if (nrow(d)) paste0("data.table's ", froll_group(d)) else character()
}
single_rows <- thr_main[thr_main$class == "flat", ]
multi_rows <- thr_main[thr_main$class != "flat", ]
# the packages without a thread control are single-threaded by the static check above
# groups are separated by semicolons, since data.table's group is a list itself
single_other <- c(calls_other(single_rows), unctl, if (ver[["runstats"]] != "not installed") "runstats")
single_calls_txt <- paste(c(if (length(single_other)) join_and(single_other), calls_dt(single_rows)), collapse = "; ")
multi_other <- calls_other(multi_rows)
multi_calls_txt <- paste(c(if (length(multi_other)) join_and(multi_other), calls_dt(multi_rows)), collapse = "; ")
multi_txt <- if (nrow(multi_rows)) sprintf("The calls the threads table shows using more than one thread (%s) can use both kinds of core.", multi_calls_txt) else
  "No call in the threads table uses more than one thread."
dt_agree_txt <- if (nrow(dt_flat)) sprintf("data.table's default and one-thread timings of its single-threaded calls (%s) are within %s of each other.",
                                           froll_group(dt_flat), within_pct(dt_flat$ratio)) else ""

# the cross-check: the table's one-thread RcppRoll mean against the 1e7-row
# rate and the two pinned figures; the sentence names the figures it agrees with
within_x <- function(a, b) isTRUE(a / b <= th_x && a / b >= 1 / th_x)
x_apart <- function(a, b) fmt_x(max(a, b) / min(a, b), 2)
xc_main <- med("mean", "RcppRoll (1 thread)", w_mid)
xc_ext <- ext_med("ungrouped mean", "RcppRoll (1 thread)", w_mid) * n_rows / ext_rows
xc_ext_ok <- within_x(xc_main, xc_ext)
xc_fast_ok <- within_x(xc_main, core_med("fast")); xc_slow_ok <- within_x(xc_main, core_med("slow"))
xc_ok <- xc_ext_ok && (!core_clean || xc_fast_ok || xc_slow_ok)
xc_core_figs <- if (core_clean) sprintf(", %s ms on a fast core and %s ms on a slow one", fmt_ms(core_med("fast")), fmt_ms(core_med("slow"))) else ""
xc_figs <- c(ext = sprintf("the %s-row rate", ext_txt), fast = "the fast-core figure", slow = "the slow-core figure")
xc_vals <- c(ext = xc_ext, fast = core_med("fast"), slow = core_med("slow"))
xc_hit <- c(ext = xc_ext_ok, fast = xc_fast_ok, slow = xc_slow_ok)
xc_have <- !is.na(xc_vals)
xc_miss <- names(xc_vals)[xc_have & !xc_hit]
xc_miss_txt <- join_and(vapply(xc_miss, function(k) sprintf("%s away from %s", x_apart(xc_main, xc_vals[[k]]), xc_figs[[k]]), ""))
xc_hits <- xc_figs[xc_have & xc_hit]
xc_agree_txt <- if (length(xc_hits)) sprintf("agrees with %s within a factor of %s", join_and(xc_hits), th_x) else ""
xc_verdict <- if (is.na(xc_main)) {
  "RcppRoll's one-thread mean was not timed at this width, so there is nothing to cross-check."
} else if (!xc_ok) {
  sprintf("The table figure %s%s, so the one-thread RcppRoll cells of this render are suspect and the run should be repeated.",
          if (nzchar(xc_agree_txt)) paste(xc_agree_txt, "but is ") else "is ", xc_miss_txt)
} else {
  paste0("The table figure ", xc_agree_txt,
         if (length(xc_miss)) paste0(" and is ", xc_miss_txt) else "",
         if (!core_clean) "." else if (xc_fast_ok && !xc_slow_ok) ", so this render's one-thread RcppRoll cell ran at fast-core speed." else
           if (xc_slow_ok && !xc_fast_ok) ", so this render's one-thread RcppRoll cell ran at slow-core speed." else
           "; the two pinned figures are too close to tell which kind of core it ran on.")
}
# a disturbed pinning measurement is left out of the cross-check, and the text says so
if (core_ok && !core_clean) xc_verdict <- paste(xc_verdict, "The pinned figures of chunk `bench-cores` are not used here, because that measurement was disturbed (see above).")

# the one call this render timed twice in different chunks
rs_moved_txt <- if (!have_rs) "" else if (!rs_within(rs_main[["mean"]], rs_side("mean", "outside")))
  sprintf("One call did move between chunks: the runstats mean call took %s ms in the results table and %s ms in chunk %s of the same render (%s apart). This report does not establish why; core placement is a possible cause, not a shown one.",
          fmt_ms(rs_main[["mean"]]), fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "outside")), code("bench-runstats-shift"), x_apart(rs_main[["mean"]], rs_side("mean", "outside"))) else
  sprintf("The runstats mean call, timed in two chunks of this render, took %s ms in the results table and %s ms in chunk %s.",
          fmt_ms(rs_main[["mean"]]), fmt_ms(rs_side("mean", "outside")), code("bench-runstats-shift"))
n_cells <- nrow(cr); n_ok <- sum(cr$ok); n_err <- sum(grepl("^error:", cr$note))
n_cells_all <- n_cells + n_skip_main
bad <- cr[!cr$ok, ]
alias_diff <- unlist(lapply(setdiff(stats_main, "median"), function(s) vapply(widths, function(w) med(s, "cuplyr (froll alias)", w) - med(s, "cuplyr", w), 0)))
# cells where either entry was not timed are not compared
alias_diff <- alias_diff[!is.na(alias_diff)]
alias_txt <- if (!length(alias_diff)) "no cell has both entries timed, so the two were not compared" else if (all(alias_diff > 0)) sprintf("the alias was %s-%s ms slower than native in each of the %s cells, i.e. within %s ms", fmt_ms(min(alias_diff)), fmt_ms(max(alias_diff)), length(alias_diff), format(ceiling(max(alias_diff) * 10) / 10)) else
  sprintf("the alias differed from native by %s to %s ms across %s cells (slower in %s of them)", fmt_ms(min(alias_diff)), fmt_ms(max(alias_diff)), length(alias_diff), sum(alias_diff > 0))
n_caught <- sum(cr$fell_back %in% TRUE)
skip_intro <- if (n_skip) "These cells were not timed; the reason is the message of the probe call. None of them has a row in `timings.csv` or `correctness.csv`; they are listed in `skipped.csv`." else "No cell was skipped in this run, so there is nothing to list."
median_panel_txt <- if (median_skipped) "The median table and plot carry a note instead of a cuplyr number, because that call is not timed; every cuplyr entry that is timed is computation only." else "Every cuplyr entry is computation only."
denom_txt <- if (n_skip_main == 0) "No cell was skipped, so it is every cell the benchmark planned." else
  sprintf("%s planned %s skipped as CPU fallbacks and are neither timed nor checked, so the count is %s, not %s.", cap1(words(n_skip_main)), plural(n_skip_main, "cell was", "cells were"), n_cells, n_cells_all)
skip_count_txt <- if (!n_skip) "No cell was skipped in this run." else
  sprintf("%s %s skipped in this run: %s; they are listed in the table below and in `skipped.csv`.", cap1(words(n_skip)), plural(n_skip, "cell was", "cells were"), skip_summary)
caught_txt <- if (n_caught == 0) "none was raised by a timed cell" else sprintf("%s raised by a timed cell, which is a bug in the probe and invalidates that cell", words(n_caught))
median_entry_txt <- if (median_skipped) sprintf("There is no cuplyr median entry: %s has no cudf kernel in %s and runs through an R loop on collected data, so it is not timed.", code("roll_median()"), cudf_ver_short) else
  "The median has a native cuplyr entry in this run."
dt_med_rng <- range_ms(med_w("median", "data.table"))

# ---- install logs -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
logs <- sort(setdiff(list.files(params$out_dir, pattern = "^install.*\\.log$"), "install-engines.log"))
log_failed <- lapply(logs, function(f) {
  l <- readLines(file.path(params$out_dir, f), warn = FALSE)
  m <- regmatches(l, regexec("^\\s*(\\S+)\\s+(?:<NA>|\\S+)\\s+not run: install failed", l))
  unique(vapply(Filter(length, m), function(z) z[2], ""))
})
log_notes <- c("install-attempt1-pixi-toolchain.log" = "", "install-attempt2-path-only.log" = "PATH only",
               "install-attempt3-env.log" = "roll via RcppParallel's TBB configure, runstats via missing fftwtools, RollingWindow format-security",
               "install-attempt4.log" = "RollingWindow only: the first flag attempt, PKG_CXXFLAGS, did not override the later -Werror",
               "install.log" = "final run")
log_table <- data.frame(log = logs, failed = vapply(log_failed, function(z) if (length(z)) paste(z, collapse = ", ") else "none", ""),
                        note = ifelse(logs %in% names(log_notes), log_notes[logs], ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
all_installed <- all(ver[bench_pkgs] != "not installed")
missing_pkgs <- names(ver)[ver == "not installed"]
last_clean <- length(logs) > 0 && length(log_failed[[length(logs)]]) == 0
install_lead <- if (all_installed) "Everything the benchmark needs is installed; nothing is \"not run: install failed\"" else
  sprintf("These packages are not installed, so their entries are missing: %s", join_and(missing_pkgs))
knitr_dir <- dirname(find.package("knitr")); rmd_dir <- dirname(find.package("rmarkdown"))
deps_where <- unique(c(knitr_dir, rmd_dir))
deps_in_lib <- all(normalizePath(deps_where, mustWork = FALSE) == normalizePath(params$lib, mustWork = FALSE))
deps_txt <- sprintf("they were found in %s (%s), and rendering this document installs nothing", join_and(code(deps_where)),
                    if (deps_in_lib) "the benchmark library" else "not the benchmark library")
install_runs <- if (length(logs) > 1) sprintf("It took %s install runs because", words(length(logs))) else "The install needed care because"

# ---- the statement about grouping F-findings ---------------------------------------------------------------
worst_stat <- { s <- intersect(c("mean", "sum", "min", "max", "sd"), stats_main); r <- vapply(s, function(z) med(z, "cuplyr", w_hi) / med(z, "cuplyr", w_mid), 0); names(which.max(r)) }
f2_lead <- if (!cup_grow_known) sprintf("Whether the rolling kernels slow down with the window width is not known from this run (%s).", grow_unknown_why) else
  if (cup_grows) sprintf("Rolling kernels slow down with the window width; %s is the worst.", worst_stat) else "Rolling kernels do not slow down strongly with the window width in this run."
u_hi <- function(fn) ext_med("ungrouped mean", fn, w_hi)
dt_med_1t_rng <- range_ms(med_w("median", "data.table (1 thread)"))
ptr_txt <- if (ptr_probe[["dollar_null"]]) paste0("returns NULL (tibble's ", code("$"), "), so helper code has to use ", code(".subset2()")) else
  paste0("works from outside the namespace (checked in this run), so helper code need not use ", code(".subset2()"))
f2_infer <- if (!cup_grow_known) "" else if (cup_grows) "The scaling suggests the kernel rescans each window (inference; not profiled)." else "The widths do not show strong growth in this run, so there is no evidence of a rescan here."
f2_row_if <- if (cup_grows) "Candidate row" else "Candidate row (only if the growth shows up in a later run)"
f3_body <- if (median_skipped) sprintf("%s (%s) loops in R, and it is not timed anywhere in this report. Candidate rows: (a) cheap, call %s (%s here at %s threads, %s at one thread across the three widths) inside the fallback; (b) real, a GPU rolling median (cudf %s has no MEDIAN rolling aggregation).",
  code("roll_apply_generic"), code("R/roll.R"), code("data.table::frollmedian"), dt_med_rng, n_dt_threads, dt_med_1t_rng, cudf_ver_short) else ""
f3_lead <- if (median_skipped) sprintf("%s's CPU fallback is an R loop, not measured in this report.", code("roll_median()")) else
  sprintf("%s has no CPU fallback in this run.", code("roll_median()"))
```

```{r}
#| label: claims-engines
#| include: false
# polars and DuckDB (F73): the install record, the thread counts read back from
# the engines, and every statement about where cuplyr wins and loses against
# them. These count every entry (the post's packages and both engines); the
# statements about the post's own packages are in the chunk above and stay
# scoped to post_fns.

# ---- the install record (written by the install run, read here, never typed) -----------
inst_path <- file.path(params$out_dir, "install-engines.csv")
inst <- if (file.exists(inst_path)) utils::read.csv(inst_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else NULL
inst_table <- if (is.null(inst)) NULL else data.frame(
  package = inst$package, version = inst$version,
  repository = ifelse(is.na(inst$repo) | !nzchar(inst$repo), "(not installed here)", inst$repo),
  how = inst$how, install_time = vapply(inst$secs, function(z) if (is.na(z)) "-" else fmt_dur(z), ""), status = inst$status,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
inst_row_txt <- function(i) {
  r <- inst[i, ]
  if (is.na(r$secs)) sprintf("%s %s was %s (%s)", code(r$package), r$version, r$status, r$how)
  else sprintf("%s %s: %s; %s", code(r$package), r$version, r$how, fmt_dur(r$secs))
}
inst_txt <- if (is.null(inst)) "No install record (install-engines.csv) was found next to the output, so how polars and DuckDB were installed is not described here." else
  paste0("The install of the engines, read from install-engines.csv in the output directory: ", paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(inst)), inst_row_txt, ""), collapse = ". "), ".")
inst_note_txt <- if (is.null(inst)) "" else sprintf(" The %s build compiles at R's default flags, not at the flags DuckDB uses for its own releases, so its speed here is the speed of this build; %s downloads a prebuilt Rust library and was not built with cargo.",
                                                    code("duckdb"), code("polars"))

# ---- the engines' per-call floor (bench-engines, on the small table) --------------------
# The same measurement as cuplyr's floor: one call on a small table, where the
# computation is negligible, at the middle width, the median over the statistics of
# each statistic's median.
stopifnot(identical(bench_engines$small_rows, small_rows))
eng_floor_df <- bench_engines$floor
eng_floor <- function(label) {
  d <- eng_floor_df[eng_floor_df$fn == paste0(label, " (1e3-row overhead floor)"), ]
  stats::median(tapply(d$ms, d$stat, stats::median))
}
eng_floor_ms <- stats::setNames(vapply(unname(eng_labels), eng_floor, 0), unname(eng_labels))
eng_floor_n <- length(unique(eng_floor_df$stat))
eng_floor_txt <- sprintf("For comparison, the same call at w=%s on the %s-row table, measured the same way for the engines (the median over the %s statistics of each statistic's median; chunk `bench-engines`, samples in `timings.csv`), takes %s ms for polars (%s ms at one thread) and %s ms for DuckDB (%s ms at one thread). DuckDB's figure includes the sort that its `ORDER BY i` implies; I did not time that sort separately.",
                         w_mid, small_txt, words(eng_floor_n), fmt_ms(eng_floor_ms[["polars"]]), fmt_ms(eng_floor_ms[["polars (1 thread)"]]),
                         fmt_ms(eng_floor_ms[["DuckDB"]]), fmt_ms(eng_floor_ms[["DuckDB (1 thread)"]]))

# ---- the thread counts in effect ---------------------------------------------------------
eng_thr_tab <- data.frame(engine = engine_threads$engine, configuration = engine_threads$config,
                          setting = ifelse(engine_threads$engine == "DuckDB",
                                           ifelse(engine_threads$config == "1 thread", "SET threads = 1", "(default)"),
                                           ifelse(engine_threads$config == "1 thread", "POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1", "(unset)")),
                          threads_in_effect = engine_threads$threads, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# how an engine's one-thread / default ratios read, per statistic, in the document's words
eng_how <- function(r) {
  if (all(r$class == "scales")) "scales on every statistic" else if (all(r$class == "flat")) "does not scale on any statistic" else
    paste(c(if (any(r$class == "scales")) paste("scales for", join_and(r$statistic[r$class == "scales"])),
            if (any(r$class == "weak")) paste("scales only weakly for", join_and(r$statistic[r$class == "weak"])),
            if (any(r$class == "flat")) paste("does not scale for", join_and(r$statistic[r$class == "flat"]))), collapse = "; ")
}
# The measured thread behaviour of an engine in one clause, for the Conclusions:
# what the threads table shows (the one-thread / default ratio), not the pool size.
eng_lead <- function(e) {
  r <- thr_eng[thr_eng$entry == e & thr_eng$kind == "main", ]
  if (!nrow(r)) return(sprintf("%s has no one-thread control in this run", e))
  if (all(r$class == "flat")) sprintf("%s ran effectively on one thread (one-thread / default ratio %s), although its pool has %s threads", e, range_num(r$ratio), engine_default_threads(e))
  else if (all(r$class == "scales")) sprintf("%s scaled with its threads on every statistic (pool of %s; %s slower at one thread)", e, engine_default_threads(e), range_x(r$ratio))
  else sprintf("%s %s (one-thread / default ratio %s)", e, eng_how(r), range_num(r$ratio))
}
eng_lead_txt <- paste(vapply(eng_base, eng_lead, ""), collapse = "; ")
eng_default_thr <- vapply(eng_base, engine_default_threads, 0)
eng_one_thr <- vapply(eng_base, engine_one_threads, 0)
eng_reading <- function(e) {
  r <- thr_eng[thr_eng$entry == e & thr_eng$kind == "main", ]
  u <- thr_eng[thr_eng$entry == e & thr_eng$kind == "ungrouped", ]
  g <- thr_eng[thr_eng$entry == e & thr_eng$kind == "grouped", ]
  if (!nrow(r)) return(sprintf("%s has no one-thread control in this run.", e))
  how <- eng_how(r)
  # the extension ratios carry the word the document's thresholds give them
  cls_word <- c(scales = "scales", weak = "scales weakly", flat = "does not scale")
  extra <- c(if (nrow(g)) sprintf("%.2f grouped (%s)", g$ratio[1], cls_word[[g$class[1]]]),
             if (nrow(u)) sprintf("%.2f at %s rows (%s)", u$ratio[1], ext_txt, cls_word[[u$class[1]]]))
  sprintf("%s %s (one-thread / default median ratio %s at w=%s%s); it ran with %s threads by default and %s at one, as read back from the engine (`engine-threads.csv`).",
          e, how, range_num(r$ratio), w_mid, if (length(extra)) paste0("; ", paste(extra, collapse = "; ")) else "",
          engine_default_threads(e), engine_one_threads(e))
}

# ---- cuplyr against every other entry, per cell ------------------------------------------
# "Other entries" are every non-cuplyr entry at its default setting: the post's
# packages and polars and DuckDB alike. The one-thread controls are not in the
# table. verdict() is the document's own comparison (see "Comparison words").
others_at <- function(stat, w) {
  f <- unique(cells$fn[cells$stat == stat & cells$width == w])
  f[!grepl("1 thread", f) & !f %in% excl_cup]
}
mark_slightly <- function(nm, v) ifelse(grepl("slightly", v), paste0(nm, " (slightly)"), nm)
win_row <- function(where, cup, others) {
  meds <- vapply(others, function(o) o[["med"]], 0)
  have <- !is.na(cup[["med"]])
  v <- if (have) vapply(others, function(o) verdict(cup, o), "") else rep(NA_character_, length(others))
  fastest <- if (any(!is.na(meds))) names(which.min(meds)) else NA_character_
  list_or <- function(keep, lab) if (!have) "-" else if (!any(keep)) "none" else join_and(lab[keep])
  list(row = data.frame(
    where = where, cuplyr_ms = if (have) fmt_ms(cup[["med"]]) else "not timed",
    fastest_other = if (is.na(fastest)) "-" else sprintf("%s (%s)", fastest, fmt_ms(min(meds, na.rm = TRUE))),
    cuplyr_loses_to = list_or(is_slower(v), mark_slightly(names(others), v)),
    cuplyr_level_with = list_or(v %in% "level", names(others)),
    cuplyr_beats = if (!have) "-" else sprintf("%s of %s", sum(is_faster(v)), length(v)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    long = data.frame(entry = names(others), v = v, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
win_parts <- list()
add_win <- function(kind, stat, width, where, cup, others) {
  w <- win_row(where, cup, others)
  w$long$kind <- kind; w$long$stat <- stat; w$long$width <- width
  win_parts[[length(win_parts) + 1]] <<- w
}
for (s in stats_main) for (w in widths) {
  fs <- others_at(s, w)
  add_win("main", s, w, sprintf("%s, w=%s", s, w), trip(s, "cuplyr", w), stats::setNames(lapply(fs, function(f) trip(s, f, w)), fs))
}
g_fs <- setdiff(unique(ext$fn[ext$experiment == grp_lab]), "cuplyr"); g_fs <- g_fs[!grepl("1 thread", g_fs)]
add_win("grouped", "mean", group_width, sprintf("%s, %s rows, %s groups, w=%s", grp_lab, grp_rows_txt, groups_txt, group_width),
        ext_trip(grp_lab, "cuplyr", group_width), stats::setNames(lapply(g_fs, function(f) ext_trip(grp_lab, f, group_width)), g_fs))
u_fs <- setdiff(ung_fns, "cuplyr"); u_fs <- u_fs[!grepl("1 thread", u_fs)]
for (w in widths) {
  add_win("ungrouped", "mean", w, sprintf("%s, w=%s", ung_lab, w), ext_trip("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", w),
          stats::setNames(lapply(u_fs, function(f) ext_trip("ungrouped mean", f, w)), u_fs))
}
win_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(win_parts, `[[`, "row"))
win_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(win_parts, `[[`, "long"))
rownames(win_tab) <- NULL

# ---- each engine against cuplyr: ratio = engine median / cuplyr median -------------------
eng_cmp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(eng_labels, function(e) {
  m <- expand.grid(stat = stats_main, width = widths, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  main_rows <- data.frame(engine = e, kind = "main", stat = m$stat, width = m$width,
    v = mapply(function(s, w) verdict(trip(s, "cuplyr", w), trip(s, e, w)), m$stat, m$width, USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    ratio = mapply(function(s, w) med(s, e, w) / med(s, "cuplyr", w), m$stat, m$width, USE.NAMES = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  g_row <- data.frame(engine = e, kind = "grouped", stat = "mean", width = group_width,
    v = verdict(ext_trip(grp_lab, "cuplyr", group_width), ext_trip(grp_lab, e, group_width)),
    ratio = ext_med(grp_lab, e, group_width) / ext_med(grp_lab, "cuplyr", group_width), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  u_rows <- data.frame(engine = e, kind = "ungrouped", stat = "mean", width = widths,
    v = vapply(widths, function(w) verdict(ext_trip("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", w), ext_trip("ungrouped mean", e, w)), ""),
    ratio = vapply(widths, function(w) ext_med("ungrouped mean", e, w) / ext_med("ungrouped mean", "cuplyr", w), 0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rbind(main_rows, g_row, u_rows)
}))
rownames(eng_cmp) <- NULL
eng_ratio <- function(e, kind, stat, width) {
  r <- eng_cmp$ratio[eng_cmp$engine == e & eng_cmp$kind == kind & eng_cmp$stat == stat & eng_cmp$width == width]
  if (!length(r) || is.na(r)) NA_real_ else r[1]
}
ratio_rows <- rbind(
  data.frame(where = paste0(rows_txt, " rows, ", stats_main, ", w=", w_mid), kind = "main", stat = stats_main, width = w_mid, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(where = sprintf("%s, w=%s", grp_lab, group_width), kind = "grouped", stat = "mean", width = group_width, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(where = sprintf("%s, w=%s", ung_lab, w_mid), kind = "ungrouped", stat = "mean", width = w_mid, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
ratio_tab <- data.frame(row = ratio_rows$where, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (e in eng_labels) {
  ratio_tab[[e]] <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(ratio_rows)), function(i) {
    r <- eng_ratio(e, ratio_rows$kind[i], ratio_rows$stat[i], ratio_rows$width[i])
    if (is.na(r)) "cuplyr not timed" else fmt_x(r, 2)
  }, "")
}

# ---- core placement as polars' own samples show it (the paragraph is in "Hardware") ----------
# polars ran effectively on one thread, so its samples can land on either kind of
# core: the spread inside each main-grid cell (slowest over fastest sample) is the
# effect actually observed, next to the pinned ratio. And cuplyr's margin over
# polars against polars' fastest sample of each cell (the speed of a fast core, if
# the spread is core placement) says whether core placement could explain it.
pol_cells <- main[main$fn %in% c("polars", "polars (1 thread)") & main$stat %in% stats_main & main$width %in% widths, ]
pol_spread <- if (nrow(pol_cells)) vapply(split(pol_cells$ms, list(pol_cells$fn, pol_cells$stat, pol_cells$width), drop = TRUE), function(v) max(v) / min(v), 0) else numeric()
pol_margin <- unlist(lapply(stats_main, function(st) vapply(widths, function(w) {
  v <- main$ms[main$fn == "polars" & main$stat == st & main$width == w]
  if (!length(v) || !has_cell(st, "cuplyr", w)) NA_real_ else min(v) / med(st, "cuplyr", w)
}, 0)))
pol_margin <- pol_margin[!is.na(pol_margin)]
pol_single <- "polars" %in% thr_main$entry[thr_main$class == "flat"]
# The widest spread is compared with the pinned ratio: within th_x of it, the
# samples split the way pinning does; above, something besides core placement
# moved them; below, they did not visibly split across the two kinds.
core_obs_txt <- if (!core_clean || !core_matters || !pol_single || !length(pol_spread)) "" else {
  sp_max <- max(pol_spread)
  paste0(sprintf("polars ran effectively on one thread (threads table), so its own samples show what an unpinned single-threaded call meets: within each of its %s main-grid cells (default and one thread) the slowest sample is %s the fastest; the widest spread, %s, %s.",
                 words(length(pol_spread)), range_x(pol_spread, 2), fmt_x(sp_max, 2),
                 if (sp_max > core_ratio * th_x) sprintf("is more than a factor of %s above the pinned ratio, so core placement alone does not account for it", th_x) else
                   if (within_x(sp_max, core_ratio)) sprintf("agrees with the pinned ratio within a factor of %s, as when some samples land on a fast core and some on a slow one", th_x) else
                     sprintf("is more than a factor of %s below the pinned ratio, so in this render polars' samples did not visibly split between the two kinds of core", th_x)),
         # polars' fastest sample is the speed it reaches on a fast core, so a lead
         # over it is not a product of polars landing on slow cores
         if (!length(pol_margin)) "" else if (min(pol_margin) > 1) sprintf(" Even polars' fastest sample of each cell (default threads) takes at least %s as long as cuplyr's median, so core placement does not explain cuplyr's lead over polars.", fmt_x(min(pol_margin), 2)) else
           sprintf(" In at least one cell polars' fastest sample (default threads) is below cuplyr's median (it takes %s as long), so there cuplyr's lead holds for polars' typical sample but not for its fastest.", fmt_x(min(pol_margin), 2)))
}

# ---- cells whose samples fall into two groups (any entry) ---------------------------------
# Sorted, a cell's samples split into two groups where two neighbours are more than th_x
# apart, with at least two samples on each side. The median of such a cell depends on
# how many samples land in each group, and with an even split it falls between them.
tg_src <- main[main$n_rows == n_rows & !is.na(main$ms), ]
tg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(tg_src, list(tg_src$fn, tg_src$stat, tg_src$width), drop = TRUE), function(d) {
  v <- sort(d$ms); n <- length(v)
  if (n < 4L) return(NULL)
  g <- v[-1] / v[-n]; i <- which.max(g)
  if (g[i] <= th_x || i < 2L || n - i < 2L) return(NULL)
  m <- stats::median(v)
  data.frame(fn = d$fn[1], stat = d$stat[1], width = d$width[1], n = n, n_lo = i, lo_a = v[1], lo_b = v[i], hi_a = v[i + 1L], hi_b = v[n],
             med = m, between = m > v[i] && m < v[i + 1L], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
tg_n_cells <- length(unique(paste(tg_src$fn, tg_src$stat, tg_src$width)))
tg_cell <- function(d) sprintf("%s %s w=%s", d$fn, d$stat, d$width)
tg_txt <- if (is.null(tg) || !nrow(tg)) {
  sprintf("No cell's samples fall into two groups (sorted, no two neighbouring samples are more than a factor of %s apart with at least two samples on each side).", th_x)
} else {
  tg <- tg[order(tg$fn, match(tg$stat, stat_order), tg$width), ]
  tg_fns <- unique(tg$fn)
  tg_btw <- tg[tg$between, ]
  tg_pol <- all(sub(" \\(1 thread\\)$", "", tg_fns) == "polars")
  paste0(sprintf("**Two-group cells.** In %s of the %s cells the samples fall into two groups: sorted, two neighbouring samples are more than a factor of %s apart, with at least two samples on each side. %s: %s.",
                 words(nrow(tg)), tg_n_cells, th_x, if (tg_pol) "All of them are polars cells" else "They are",
                 join_and(sprintf("%s (%s at %s-%s ms, %s at %s-%s ms)", tg_cell(tg), tg$n_lo, fmt_ms(tg$lo_a), fmt_ms(tg$lo_b), tg$n - tg$n_lo, fmt_ms(tg$hi_a), fmt_ms(tg$hi_b)))),
         if (nrow(tg_btw)) sprintf(" In %s the median (%s) falls between the two groups, so it is the time of neither%s.", join_and(tg_cell(tg_btw)), join_and(paste(fmt_ms(tg_btw$med), "ms")),
                                   if (nrow(tg_btw) < nrow(tg)) "; in the others it falls inside the larger group" else "") else
           " In each of them the median falls inside the larger group.",
         if (tg_pol && pol_single) " polars ran effectively on one thread, so its samples can land on either kind of core (see \"Core placement\"); which one each sample ran on is not recorded." else "",
         " The median of such a cell depends on how many samples land in each group, so it can move between runs by more than its IQR suggests.")
}

# ---- prose pieces ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# counts over the main grid (statistic x width) where cuplyr has a number
eng_counts <- function(e) {
  d <- eng_cmp[eng_cmp$engine == e & eng_cmp$kind == "main" & !is.na(eng_cmp$v), ]
  c(n = nrow(d), faster = sum(is_faster(d$v)), level = sum(d$v %in% "level"), slower = sum(is_slower(d$v)))
}
count_txt <- function(cn) {
  if (cn[["n"]] == 0) "not compared here (cuplyr was not timed)" else
  if (cn[["faster"]] == cn[["n"]]) sprintf("faster in every one of the %s (statistic x width) cells", words(cn[["n"]])) else
  if (cn[["slower"]] == cn[["n"]]) sprintf("slower in every one of the %s (statistic x width) cells", words(cn[["n"]])) else
    sprintf("faster in %s, level in %s and slower in %s of the %s (statistic x width) cells", words(cn[["faster"]]), words(cn[["level"]]), words(cn[["slower"]]), words(cn[["n"]]))
}
eng_pat <- function(e) {
  d <- eng_cmp[eng_cmp$engine == e & eng_cmp$kind == "main" & !is.na(eng_cmp$v), c("stat", "width", "v")]
  if (!nrow(d)) "not compared" else pattern_txt(d)
}
single_kind <- function(e, kind) {
  d <- eng_cmp[eng_cmp$engine == e & eng_cmp$kind == kind, ]
  if (all(is.na(d$v))) return("not comparable")
  if (kind == "main") return(eng_pat(e))
  runs_txt(d$v, d$width, vocab_basic)
}
# the fastest entry per statistic at the middle width, cuplyr included where it was timed
all_at <- function(stat, w) {
  f <- others_at(stat, w)
  m <- c(vapply(f, function(x) med(stat, x, w), 0), if (has_cell(stat, "cuplyr", w)) c(cuplyr = med(stat, "cuplyr", w)))
  m[!is.na(m)]
}
fast_all <- vapply(stats_main, function(s) names(which.min(all_at(s, w_mid))), "")
fast_all_txt <- paste(vapply(unique(fast_all), function(n) sprintf("%s for %s", lab_cpu(n), join_and(names(fast_all)[fast_all == n])), ""), collapse = "; ")
# which of the two engines is faster per statistic (default settings): the document's
# own comparison words (verdict()), so within th_level is "level", and a cell that
# was not timed for either is left out instead of stopping the render
eng_pair_v <- vapply(stats_main, function(s) verdict(trip(s, "polars", w_mid), trip(s, "DuckDB", w_mid)), "")
eng_pair_stats <- function(keep) mark_slightly(stats_main[keep], eng_pair_v[keep])
eng_pair_parts <- c(
  if (any(is_faster(eng_pair_v))) sprintf("polars is faster for %s", join_and(eng_pair_stats(is_faster(eng_pair_v)))),
  if (any(is_slower(eng_pair_v))) sprintf("DuckDB is faster for %s", join_and(eng_pair_stats(is_slower(eng_pair_v)))),
  if (any(eng_pair_v %in% "level")) sprintf("they are level for %s", join_and(stats_main[eng_pair_v %in% "level"])),
  if (anyNA(eng_pair_v)) sprintf("they are not compared for %s (not timed)", join_and(stats_main[is.na(eng_pair_v)])))
eng_pair_txt <- if (length(eng_pair_parts)) paste(eng_pair_parts, collapse = "; ") else "they are not compared (not timed)"
eng_pair_decided <- is_faster(eng_pair_v) | is_slower(eng_pair_v)
eng_pair_ratio <- vapply(stats_main[eng_pair_decided], function(s) max(med(s, "polars", w_mid), med(s, "DuckDB", w_mid)) / min(med(s, "polars", w_mid), med(s, "DuckDB", w_mid)), 0)
eng_pair_ratio_txt <- if (length(eng_pair_ratio)) sprintf(" (where one is faster, the other takes %s as long)", range_x(eng_pair_ratio)) else ""
# A decided pair whose medians still agree within th_x, with an engine that ran
# effectively on one thread for that statistic (its samples can land on either kind
# of core), rests on this one run: the text says so instead of leaving a bare verdict.
eng_flat_at <- function(e, s) any(thr_main$entry == e & thr_main$statistic == s & thr_main$class == "flat")
eng_close <- names(eng_pair_ratio)[eng_pair_ratio < th_x]
eng_close_one <- lapply(stats::setNames(eng_close, eng_close), function(s) Filter(function(e) eng_flat_at(e, s), eng_base))
eng_close <- eng_close[lengths(eng_close_one) > 0]
eng_pair_hedge <- if (!length(eng_close)) "" else sprintf(" For %s the two still agree within a factor of %s (%s), and %s ran effectively on one thread there, so its samples can land on either kind of core (see \"Core placement\"): that order rests on this one run and may not hold in another.",
  join_and(eng_close), th_x,
  paste(vapply(eng_close, function(s) sprintf("%spolars %s ms, DuckDB %s ms", if (length(eng_close) > 1L) paste0(s, ": ") else "",
                                              fmt_ms(med(s, "polars", w_mid)), fmt_ms(med(s, "DuckDB", w_mid))), ""), collapse = "; "),
  join_and(unique(unlist(eng_close_one[eng_close]))))
# ratio ranges at the middle width, per engine and setting (below one: the engine is faster than cuplyr)
eng_rng <- function(e) {
  r <- eng_cmp$ratio[eng_cmp$engine == e & eng_cmp$kind == "main" & eng_cmp$width == w_mid]
  r <- r[!is.na(r)]
  if (!length(r)) "not compared" else range_x(r, 2)
}
cup_beats_any_eng <- any(is_faster(eng_cmp$v[eng_cmp$engine %in% eng_base & eng_cmp$kind == "main"]))
cup_loses_any_eng <- any(is_slower(eng_cmp$v[eng_cmp$engine %in% eng_base & eng_cmp$kind == "main"]))
eng_u_txt <- function(e) single_kind(e, "ungrouped")
# the same words for both engines are said once
eng_core <- function(e) sprintf("%s; by statistic, %s. Grouped: cuplyr is %s. At %s rows (one size): %s.",
                                count_txt(eng_counts(e)), eng_pat(e), single_kind(e, "grouped"), ext_txt, eng_u_txt(e))
eng_summary <- function(e) sprintf("Against %s at its default threads cuplyr is %s", e, eng_core(e))
eng_summary_both <- if (identical(eng_core("polars"), eng_core("DuckDB"))) sprintf("Against polars and DuckDB at their default threads cuplyr is %s", eng_core("polars")) else
  paste(eng_summary("polars"), eng_summary("DuckDB"))
if (median_skipped) eng_summary_both <- paste(eng_summary_both, "The median is left out of these counts, because cuplyr's is not timed.")
eng_1t_txt <- if (identical(count_txt(eng_counts("polars (1 thread)")), count_txt(eng_counts("DuckDB (1 thread)")))) sprintf("Against both engines at one thread, cuplyr is %s", count_txt(eng_counts("polars (1 thread)"))) else
  sprintf("Against the engines at one thread, cuplyr is %s for polars and %s for DuckDB", count_txt(eng_counts("polars (1 thread)")), count_txt(eng_counts("DuckDB (1 thread)")))
eng_net_txt <- if (identical(count_txt(eng_counts("polars")), count_txt(eng_counts("DuckDB")))) sprintf("against both polars and DuckDB at default threads cuplyr is %s", count_txt(eng_counts("polars"))) else
  sprintf("against polars cuplyr is %s and against DuckDB %s, both at default threads", count_txt(eng_counts("polars")), count_txt(eng_counts("DuckDB")))
# the edge semantics, in the correctness section, say what is and is not covered
eng_cells_ok <- all(cr$ok[cr$fn %in% eng_labels])
n_eng_cells <- sum(cr$fn %in% eng_labels)
```
